-Hallway A
Katei comes from the stairs. {u}According to Sai's watch, it's {time=13:50.}{/u}
-Floor 6
The attic is locked again. This time, I'm not able to unlock it with the key.
entries.new:
-水晶层
Atsuki 和我走到水晶层查看 BIOS 的时间，但监控室锁着。
-储藏室
Sai 从楼梯那边过来，我们进入了储藏室。他声称自己的记号不见了，并留下了新的记号。
-水晶层
Akaro、Erina 和 Isla 从楼梯那边过来。Atsuki 开始逐个房间搜索，并在 A5 室找到了 Sekimeiya。
-活动室
Atsuki 把 Sekimeiya 锁进了展示柜。
-A走廊
Katei 从楼梯那边过来。{u}根据 Sai 的手表，现在是 {time=13:50.}{/u}
-六楼
阁楼又锁上了。这一次，我没能用钥匙打开它。

entries.text:
-Floor 6
Atsuki opens the elevator. Two bodies are inside, as well as all the elevator buttons and panels.
-Crystal floor
Akaro brings both bodies to the lobby. Sai and Katei take the elevator to the attic.
-Event room
At Atsuki's request, I unlock the cabinet. He attempts to activate the Sekimeiya, but nothing happens.
Atsuki locks up the Sekimeiya before Sai and Katei return. When they arrive, they say that nobody was in the attic and that another key was inserted in the attic door from the inside.
-Attic
We walk to the attic and confirm that nobody is there. All of us end up dispersed throughout the rooms.
entries.new:
-六楼
Atsuki 打开了电梯。里面有两具尸体，还有所有电梯按钮和面板。
-水晶层
Akaro 把两具尸体搬到了大厅。Sai 和 Katei 乘电梯去了阁楼。
-活动室
在 Atsuki 的请求下，我打开了展示柜的锁。他试图启动 Sekimeiya，但什么也没发生。
在 Sai 和 Katei 回来之前，Atsuki 把 Sekimeiya 锁了起来。他们回来后说，阁楼里没有人，而且另一把钥匙是从里面插在阁楼门上的。
-阁楼
我们走到阁楼，确认那里没有人。最后我们所有人都分散到了各个房间里。

entries.text:
-Floor 3
Atsuki appears from the second floor and makes me rush down with him.
-Crystal floor
Erina is dead next to the stairs.
-Ashiya Tower
We regroup with the others. Sai was on the fourth floor, Katei on the fifth, and Akaro on the sixth. We're unable to find Isla in the attic.
-Crystal floor
We all see that Erina is dead. Atsuki tells us that he heard her accusing someone of being the culprit before she died.
-Event room
The Sekimeiya is in the cabinet. Thanks to a thread that Atsuki left, we can tell the glass didn't open since the last time we saw it.
-Crystal floor
We find Isla in room A1. She was told by Erina to stay there.
Everyone gives their version of what happened during the last several minutes.
We realize that Erina is also in room A1. She sees her own corpse and brings Isla to the attic.
entries.new:
-三楼
Atsuki 从二楼出现，催我跟他一起冲下去。
-水晶层
Erina 死在楼梯旁。
-芦屋塔
我们和其他人重新会合。Sai 在四楼，Katei 在五楼，Akaro 在六楼。我们在阁楼里没能找到 Isla。
-水晶层
我们都看到 Erina 死了。Atsuki 告诉我们，他听到她在死前指控某人是凶手。
-活动室
Sekimeiya 在展示柜里。多亏 Atsuki 留下的一根线，我们可以判断出玻璃自上次我们看到之后没有再打开过。
-水晶层
我们在 A1 室找到了 Isla。Erina 让她待在那里。
每个人都讲述了在过去几分钟里自己经历的事情。
我们意识到 Erina 也在 A1 室里。她看到了自己的尸体，并把 Isla 带去了阁楼。

entries.text:
-Attic
We walk to the attic after Erina and Isla.
Isla finds the Sekimeiya in a wardrobe and wraps it in a bed sheet.
-Ashiya Tower
We go downstairs, inspecting each floor in detail while transporting the Sekimeiya.
-Floor 2
We notice that the elevator panel has been reattached.
-Crystal floor
Erina's corpse and all the blood have disappeared.
entries.new:
-阁楼
我们跟着 Erina 和 Isla 走到阁楼。
Isla 在衣柜里找到了 Sekimeiya，并用床单把它包了起来。
-芦屋塔
我们带着 Sekimeiya 下楼，一边走一边仔细检查每一层。
-二楼
我们注意到电梯面板又被装了回去。
-水晶层
Erina 的尸体和所有血迹都消失了。

entries.text:
-Event room
The Sekimeiya is still locked in the cabinet, but Atsuki's thread is gone. Isla unwraps the bed sheet and can't find the Sekimeiya.
I unlock the cabinet. Sai takes the Sekimeiya out and wraps the bed sheet around it again. Through the cloth, he confirms that the Sekimeiya is getting hot.
-Hallway A
Sai unwraps the bed sheet. As he touches the Sekimeiya in its center, both the Sekimeiya and the bed sheet disappear.
-Crystal floor
We begin to search the crystal floor. In room A1, I find the Sekimeiya. The security room is unlocked again, and Sai is able to power the computer on momentarily. In the lobby, one of the two bodies is gone—{i}she{/i} disappeared again. Akaro tells us that the policeman's body disappeared earlier, but it's still on the floor. We can't find anyone in the remaining rooms, and we notice that the elevator is open on the crystal floor, completely empty.
We lock the Sekimeiya in its cabinet. Five minutes later, the {u}BIOS's time displays {time=15:45.}{/u}
I wander around the crystal floor for over an hour. 
Atsuki attempts to use the Sekimeiya, but it's still not working.
-Attic
I walk to the attic and see that all the elevator panels have been reattached.
-Left bedroom
I turn off the lights and fall asleep. After being continuously woken up by faint noises, I stand up.
entries.new:
-活动室
Sekimeiya 仍锁在展示柜里，但 Atsuki 留下的线不见了。Isla 解开床单，却找不到 Sekimeiya。
我打开了展示柜。Sai 把 Sekimeiya 取出来，又用床单把它包好。隔着布，他确认 Sekimeiya 正在变热。
-A走廊
Sai 解开床单。当他触摸 Sekimeiya 中央时，Sekimeiya 和床单一起消失了。
-水晶层
我们开始搜索水晶层。在 A1 室，我找到了 Sekimeiya。监控室又没锁了，Sai 得以短暂地启动电脑。大厅里的两具尸体少了一具——{i}她{/i}又消失了。Akaro 告诉我们，警察的尸体之前就消失了，但它现在还躺在地上。我们在其余房间里找不到任何人，并注意到水晶层的电梯门开着，里面空无一人。
我们把 Sekimeiya 锁进了它的展示柜。五分钟后，{u}BIOS 的时间显示为 {time=15:45.}{/u}
我在水晶层徘徊了一个多小时。
Atsuki 试图使用 Sekimeiya，但它仍然没有反应。
-阁楼
我走到阁楼，看到所有电梯面板都被重新装了回去。
-左侧卧室
我关掉灯，睡着了。在断断续续被微弱的声音吵醒后，我站了起来。

entries.text:
-Left bedroom
The light turns on, and a yell comes from the hallway.
-Crystal floor
I walk to the crystal floor. On the stairs, where Atsuki had been sitting, there's a trail of blood.
-Lobby
All the bodies are gone.
-Hallway B
There's a trail of blood leading to the open staff room.
-Staff room
I find a faint glow behind the door of a locker. Through the narrow slits, I reach my fingers toward it.
entries.new:
-左侧卧室
灯亮了，走廊里传来一声喊叫。
-水晶层
我走到水晶层。在 Atsuki 曾坐过的楼梯上，有一道血迹。
-大厅
所有尸体都不见了。
-B走廊
有一道血迹通向敞开的员工室。
-员工室
我发现一个储物柜的门后透出微弱的光。透过狭窄的缝隙，我把手指伸向它。

entries.text:
-Hallway A
I appear in hallway A and fall to the floor, close to the staircase.
-Security room
Katei's dead body is on the floor. The computer is powered on, and when I press a key, the screens light up showing a message: "{time=10:04}: Camera(s) disabled and associated footage erased". The {u}time displayed is {time=18:21.}{/u}
-Event room
The cabinet is empty.
-Hallway B
Erina appears behind me. She's covered in blood and doesn't recognize me.
-Crystal room B4
Naomi's body is covered by a curtain on the floor. Drawn by a broken wheel, I find the Sekimeiya inside a cabinet set to 0ºC.
entries.new:
-A走廊
我出现在 A走廊，摔倒在地，靠近楼梯。
-监控室
Katei 的尸体躺在地上。电脑开着，我按下一个键后，屏幕亮起，显示出一条信息：“{time=10:04}: 摄像头已停用，相关录像已删除”。{u}显示的时间是 {time=18:21.}{/u}
-活动室
展示柜是空的。
-B走廊
Erina 出现在我身后。她浑身是血，认不出我。
-水晶展室 B4
Naomi 的尸体被地上的帘子盖着。被一个损坏的轮子吸引，我发现 Sekimeiya 在一个设定为 0ºC 的展示柜里。

entries.text:
-Event room
We leave the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
-Crystal room A5
Isla is dead inside a cabinet.
Atsuki's yell reaches my ears. He's yelling {i}her{/i} name.
-Crystal floor
I run to the stairs and see Erina following the sound. I attempt to listen from hallway C.
To hear inside the event room, I enter the staff room and place my ear against the left wall.
-Staff room
I make out people saying that I should be dead.
I realize that the Sekimeiya was activated and disappeared from the event room.
entries.new:
-活动室
我们把 Sekimeiya 留在了展示柜里。
-水晶展室 A5
Isla 死在一个展示柜里。
Atsuki 的喊声传到我耳中。他在喊{i}她{/i}的名字。
-水晶层
我跑到楼梯处，看到 Erina 正循着声音过去。我试着从 C走廊偷听。
为了听到活动室里面的声音，我进入员工室，把耳朵贴在左侧墙上。
-员工室
我辨认出有人在说，我早就该死了。
我意识到 Sekimeiya 被启动了，并从活动室里消失了。

entries.text:
-Floor 5
I find Atsuki as I'm running up. He tells me that he went down to look for me when he realized that I wasn't in the bedroom anymore.
-Floor 6
Another Atsuki appears from the partition corridor.
He tells us that everything will turn out fine if we follow his instructions. He brings the Sekimeiya from the attic and asks us to wait in the second partition of the second floor.
-Floor 2
We stay in the second partition. Almost immediately, we hear the elevator twice.
Many minutes later, we hear the elevator twice again.
entries.new:
-五楼
我往上跑时遇到了 Atsuki。他告诉我，当他发现我已经不在卧室后，就下楼来找我了。
-六楼
另一个 Atsuki 从隔间走廊里出现。
他告诉我们，只要按他的指示做，一切都会好起来。他从阁楼带来了 Sekimeiya，并让我们在二楼的第二个隔间里等着。
-二楼
我们待在第二个隔间里。几乎立刻，我们就听到电梯响了两次。
许多分钟之后，我们又听到电梯响了两次。

entries.text:
-Floor 2
Sai and Akaro see us as they're running up.
We hear the elevator a fifth and sixth time. Sai chases it up and tells Akaro to wait in front of the storeroom.
-Event room
Following the other Atsuki's directions, we lock the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
-Crystal room
Naomi's body is back in the lobby, next to the policeman. Katei is in the security room in front of the black screens. Erina and Isla are waiting in room A1.
-Event room
Sai returns from the stairs, claiming not to have found anyone. We go to the event room and see the Sekimeiya in the cabinet.
{u}Sai's wristwatch displays {time=19:32.}{/u} We wait for the shutter to unlock, and Katei shortly joins us.
entries.new:
-二楼
Sai 和 Akaro 往上跑时看到了我们。
我们听到电梯第五次和第六次响起。Sai 追着它上去，并让 Akaro 在储藏室门前等着。
-活动室
按照另一个 Atsuki 的指示，我们把 Sekimeiya 锁进了展示柜。
-水晶展室
Naomi 的尸体回到了大厅，就在警察旁边。Katei 在监控室里，面对着黑掉的屏幕。Erina 和 Isla 在 A1 室里等着。
-活动室
Sai 从楼梯那边回来，声称没找到任何人。我们去了活动室，看到 Sekimeiya 在展示柜里。
{u}Sai 的手表显示 {time=19:32.}{/u} 我们等着卷帘门解锁，Katei 不久后也加入了我们。

entries.text:
-Ashiya Tower
Miiya leaves the event room and runs upstairs, claiming to want to search the entire building. Sai takes the elevator up to chase her while Atsuki, Akaro, and Katei go up the stairs.
On the sixth floor, the three men find Miiya. She doesn't seem to remember anything, and there's blood in the staircase that seems to be hers.
Sai's dead body is found in a bedroom. After failing to discover anyone in the attic, Akaro and Katei find Atsuki's body in a pool of blood in the living room. Miiya is gone.
Erina and Isla's dead bodies are in the event room. Katei runs to the cabinet and unlocks it right before the hallway B door opens. A minute later, Akaro's corpse drops beside the two girls.
{u}At {time=21}{/u}, no trace of life remains in the building. The police rush in and find all the corpses. They're able to conclude that everyone was killed by someone else, but that was as far as their investigation could go.
Ending: Reward
entries.new:
-芦屋塔
Miiya 离开活动室往楼上跑，说要搜索整栋建筑。Sai 乘电梯上去追她，而 Atsuki、Akaro 和 Katei 走楼梯上去。
在六楼，那三个男人找到了 Miiya。她似乎什么都不记得了，楼梯上还有像是她的血。
Sai 的尸体在一间卧室里被发现。在阁楼里没有发现任何人后，Akaro 和 Katei 在客厅的一滩血里找到了 Atsuki 的尸体。Miiya 不见了。
Erina 和 Isla 的尸体在活动室里。就在 B走廊的门打开之前，Katei 跑向展示柜并打开了锁。一分钟后，Akaro 的尸体落在两个女孩旁边。
{u}到了 {time=21}{/u}，建筑里已经没有任何生命迹象。警察冲了进来，找到了所有尸体。他们能够断定每个人都是被他人杀死的，但调查也只能到此为止。
结局：奖赏

entries.text:
-Event room
Five minutes after {u}Sai's wristwatch displays {time=20:43}{/u}, we hear a sound coming from the lobby.
-Lobby
We see the shutter rising.
The sound wakes up Naomi, who instantly accuses one of us of being a murderer and another as the culprit behind the attack.
entries.new:
-活动室
在 {u}Sai 的手表显示 {time=20:43}{/u} 五分钟后，我们听到大厅传来一个声音。
-大厅
我们看到卷帘门正在升起。
声音吵醒了 Naomi，她立刻指控我们中的一个人是杀人犯，另一个人是袭击的幕后黑手。

entries.text:
-Yushibana
The police are waiting in front of Ashiya Tower for the shutter to unlock. Suripo hasn't been able to find Vaisude in a long time.
{u}At {time=21}{/u}, the shutter rises. Nobody is in the lobby, and the police are taken aback by the smell inside the building. Viewing the hall with an optical gas imaging camera reveals that there's an invisible gas present in the tower.
Wearing protective suits, a team of policemen rushes in. They find corpses in the security room, B4, A5, and in the men's bathroom. Above the first staircase is a girl with blue hair. Once taken outside, she reveals that her name is Shiroya.
A second policeman returns to the lobby and reports the four deaths. Nobody else was found alive, but an egg-shaped gemstone was in the attic, and it was placed in the event room's cabinet as instructed.
When two more policemen come back, one of them inquires about a movable wall found in the storeroom. Confused, they walk to the left side of the tower and make out a hidden door around the bricks. After picking the lock, they find themselves in the storeroom.
The fifth and last policeman leaves the tower. His report is the same, but he's holding a note that he found on the first floor.
entries.new:
-丰花
警察在芦屋塔前等着卷帘门解锁。Suripo 已经很久没能找到 Vaisude 了。
{u}到了 {time=21}{/u}，卷帘门升了起来。大厅里没有人，建筑里的气味让警察们吃了一惊。用光学气体成像仪查看大厅后，他们发现塔内存在一种看不见的气体。
一队警察穿着防护服冲了进去。他们在监控室、B4、A5 和男卫生间里发现了尸体。第一段楼梯上方有一个蓝发女孩。被带到外面后，她说出了自己的名字：Shiroya。
第二名警察回到大厅，报告了四起死亡。没有发现其他活人，但阁楼里有一颗蛋形宝石，而且它已按照指示被放进了活动室的展示柜。
当另外两名警察回来时，其中一人问起在储藏室发现的一堵可移动的墙。他们感到困惑，走到塔的左侧，在砖块周围辨认出一道暗门。撬开锁后，他们发现自己来到了储藏室里。
第五名、也是最后一名警察离开了塔。他的报告与前几人相同，但他手里拿着一张在一楼发现的纸条。

entries.text:
-Yushibana
A girl travels from Ashiya Tower to fifteen days in the past. She appears on a street in Yushibana and rushes to a gem shop.
She moves the body of her friend Miiya away from danger. Then, as she's lifting her own body, the lights of the shop turn on, causing an explosion and making her fall through the floor.
entries.new:
-丰花
一个女孩从芦屋塔穿越到了十五天前。她出现在丰花的一条街上，并冲向一家宝石店。
她把朋友 Miiya 的尸体移离危险。然后，当她抬起自己的身体时，店里的灯亮了，引发了一场爆炸，使她跌穿了地板。

entries.text:
-Lobby
After a very long wait, the hallway doors open at {time=9.}
-Ashiya Tower
A long day full of mysteries begins.
entries.new:
-大厅
经过漫长的等待，走廊的门在 {time=9.} 打开了。
-芦屋塔
充满谜团的漫长一天开始了。

entries.text:
-Right bedroom
Sai and I appear in the right bedroom of the attic. Thanks to my knife, I'm able to restrain him inside.
Sai escapes the bedroom with the key and I end up trapped.
I hear noises outside of the bedroom. Minutes later, Sai reappears inside, and I manage to restrain him again.
Sai escapes after I climb up the ladder in search of the key.
I realize what Sai did and leave the bedroom.
entries.new:
-右侧卧室
Sai 和我出现在阁楼的右侧卧室里。多亏我的刀，我得以把他制伏在里面。
Sai 带着钥匙逃出了卧室，我反而被困住了。
我听到卧室外有动静。几分钟后，Sai 又出现在里面，我再次设法制伏了他。
我爬上梯子找钥匙后，Sai 逃走了。
我明白了 Sai 做了什么，然后离开了卧室。

entries.text:
-Floor 6
I reunite with Atsuki, Erina, and Sai on the sixth floor.
-Floor 5
Atsuki tells me that the past can be changed.
-Crystal floor
We can't find the Sekimeiya. When {u}Sai's wristwatch displays {time=19:50}{/u}, we begin to wait in the lobby, but Atsuki and I intend to find the Sekimeiya before {time=21.}
At approximately {time=20:25} according to Sai's wristwatch, I go to the bathroom.
-Women's bathroom
I find the Sekimeiya inside the water tank, surrounded by a burning aura. I touch it and disappear from Ashiya Tower.
entries.new:
-六楼
我在六楼与 Atsuki、Erina 和 Sai 重新会合。
-五楼
Atsuki 告诉我，过去是可以改变的。
-水晶层
我们找不到 Sekimeiya。当 {u}Sai 的手表显示 {time=19:50}{/u} 时，我们开始在大厅里等待，但 Atsuki 和我打算在 {time=21.} 之前找到 Sekimeiya。
根据 Sai 的手表，大约在 {time=20:25}，我去了卫生间。
-女卫生间
我发现 Sekimeiya 在水箱里，周围环绕着灼热的光晕。我碰了它，然后从芦屋塔消失了。

entries.text:
-Yushibana
I wake up in an underground tunnel. My whole body hurts, and I'm wearing the clothes I wore on November 30th. {u}My phone displays {time=21:10}{/u}, and when {u}I check the date settings, they read November 30th{/u}. 
I walk out of the tunnel and find myself high on a mountain in front of Yushibana.
I wander through the dim streets and end up at Musashi Gemstones. Then, I quietly walk to my apartment.
-Home
Nobody is home, and everything looks like it did on November 30th.
I quickly fall asleep in my bed. The sound of fireworks wakes me up momentarily, and I'm able to see them through my window.
entries.new:
-丰花
我在地下隧道里醒来。我全身疼痛，身上穿着我 11月30日穿的衣服。{u}我的手机显示 {time=21:10}{/u}，而当我{u}查看日期设置时，上面显示的是 11月30日{/u}。
我走出隧道，发现自己身在丰花前方的一座高山上。
我在昏暗的街道间游荡，最后来到了武藏宝石。然后，我悄悄走回自己的公寓。
-家
家里没人，一切都像 11月30日那样。
我很快就在床上睡着了。烟花的声音短暂地把我吵醒，我透过窗户看到了它们。

entries.text:
-Home
I wake up. In my living room, I think in more detail about what happened to me.
-Yushibana
I leave my apartment and go to Ina Café.
-Ina Café
I talk with Darfee after a long time without seeing him. I read through a newspaper that mentions Miiya's death and a prisoner escaping from a cell.
-Yushibana
I end up in front of Atsuki's house.
entries.new:
-家
我醒了过来。在客厅里，我更仔细地回想发生在我身上的事。
-丰花
我离开公寓，去了伊娜咖啡馆。
-伊娜咖啡馆
我见到了很久没见的 Darfee，和他聊了聊。我翻看了一份报纸，上面提到了 Miiya 的死讯以及一名囚犯越狱的事。
-丰花
我最后来到了 Atsuki 的家门前。

entries.text:
-Home
I return home. To confirm that the past can be changed, I call my mom.
I cook a bit of meat and spend the rest of the day in my living room, trying to sort my thoughts out.
I go to sleep soon after {u}my phone displays {time=17:57.}{/u}
entries.new:
-家
我回到家。为了确认过去可以被改变，我给妈妈打了电话。
我煮了一点肉，然后在客厅里度过了余下的一天，试图理清思绪。
在 {u}我的手机显示 {time=17:57.}{/u} 之后不久，我就去睡了。

entries.text:
-Bedroom
I wake up in the morning and grab my phone. Trying to uncover the first traces of the Sekimeiya, I come across a forum thread posted on November 24th. It mentions the Sekimeiya event, and I come to the conclusion that the writer must've traveled to the past from December 15th.
-Living room
I think of locating the forum poster through a picture they posted.
-Yushibana
I reach the place where the picture might've been taken from.
-Apartment
I'm taken to an apartment up for sale. The tenant fits the description of the person I'm looking for.
I don't recognize him, but as I'm leaving, his piercing look leaves me in a daze. Immediately, someone else who enters the building seems to throw me an identical glance.
entries.new:
-卧室
我早上醒来，拿起手机。为了找出 Sekimeiya 的最早线索，我偶然看到一个 11月24日发布的论坛帖子。帖子提到了 Sekimeiya 活动，我得出结论：发帖人一定是从 12月15日穿越到过去的。
-客厅
我想通过发帖人贴出的照片找到他。
-丰花
我来到了那张照片可能被拍下的地点。
-公寓
我被带去看一间待售公寓。租客符合我要找的人的描述。
我不认识他，但就在我离开时，他那锐利的目光让我一阵恍惚。紧接着，另一个进入大楼的人似乎也向我投来了同样的目光。

entries.text:
-Yushibana
In Ramon street, I feel the same gazes all around me.
I walk to the outskirts, trying to cool off my head, but I sense someone behind me near the park. I don't see anyone, but I spot footprints running away in the snow.
-Living room
I heat up precooked meat and calm myself down, focusing on my objective.
I receive a call from Vaisude, the owner of the apartment I visited. He confirms that he wrote the forum post, and both of us tell each other that we traveled to the past.
-Home
I take a bath before going to sleep.
entries.new:
-丰花
在拉蒙街，我感到四周都是同样的目光。
我走到郊区，想让头脑冷静下来，但在公园附近感觉到身后有人。我看不到任何人，却发现雪地里有跑开的脚印。
-客厅
我热了一些熟肉，让自己冷静下来，把注意力集中在目标上。
我接到了 Vaisude 的电话，他是我看过的那间公寓的房东。他确认论坛帖子是他写的，我们俩都告诉对方自己穿越到了过去。
-家
我洗了个澡，然后去睡觉。

entries.text:
-Home
{u}My phone displays {time=7:45}{/u} when I wake up.
I eat some almonds and step out of my apartment.
-Yushibana
The streets of Yushibana are foggy and barren. I make my way through the town until I arrive at Ina, which I find closed for the first time in my life.
After waiting under a stone roof for a long time, Darfee raises Ina's shutter from the inside, and I step in.
-Ina Café
I sit at a table until noon, when I see Isla's purse beyond the window and run out to chase it.
entries.new:
-家
我醒来时，{u}我的手机显示 {time=7:45}{/u}。
我吃了一些杏仁，然后走出公寓。
-丰花
丰花的街道雾蒙蒙的，空无一人。我穿过小镇，来到伊娜咖啡馆，发现它关着门——这是我人生中第一次见到它关门。
我在一处石屋檐下等了很久之后，Darfee 从里面拉开了伊娜咖啡馆的卷帘门，我走了进去。
-伊娜咖啡馆
我坐在桌边一直到中午，随后透过窗户看到了 Isla 的手提包，便跑出去追它。

entries.text:
-Yushibana
I end up at what I believe to be Isla's house after following tiny footprints.
I'm drawn out after I feel someone near me, but I can't find anyone. I walk away until I'm on the outskirts of Yushibana, where I mindlessly take a path up a mountain.
I see the entirety of Yushibana from farther up the path.
entries.new:
-丰花
我跟着小小的脚印，最后来到了我认为是 Isla 家的地方。
感觉到附近有人后，我被引了出来，但我找不到任何人。我一路走开，直到来到丰花的郊外，然后漫无目的地沿着一条山路往上走。
从更上面的小路上，我看到了丰花的全貌。

entries.text:
-Yushibana
Shiroya's inaction alters the flow of events leading to this point. After touching the Sekimeiya in Ashiya Tower, Shiroya finds herself underground. Once she makes it out, she is able to roam free in Yushibana, and she ends up at her apartment.
The next day, she wakes up and decides to walk to Ina Café. When she gets there, however, she finds a note regarding its temporary shutdown.
The braking of a car startles Shiroya. When she steps to the car in the middle of the road, she finds Atsuki lying on the ground. After the police arrive on the scene, they take Shiroya away by force.
On {u}January 11th of 2012{/u}, Shiroya is released. She walks to her apartment, having heard long ago about what had happened on December 15th: nobody had been found alive in Ashiya Tower. The corpses of Naomi Cabca and Isla Majutsu had been all the police encountered within an unidentifiable gas. In January, Sai Yomiya, Akaro Esata, and Erina Majutsu were still missing.
The aftermath of the attack causes Ashiya Tower to remain closed until it is bought anonymously. Soon, it is announced that Ashiya Tower will be demolished.
On October 4th at {time=12}, the long-standing building falls down. A week later, as the debris is being cleaned, the shattered bodies of the three missing people are found deep under the rubble.     
Ending: Forsaken Relay
entries.new:
-丰花
Shiroya 的不作为改变了导致此刻的一系列事件。在芦屋塔触碰 Sekimeiya 后，Shiroya 发现自己身处地下。等她脱身之后，她得以在丰花自由行动，最后来到了自己的公寓。
第二天，她醒来后决定走去伊娜咖啡馆。然而到了那里，她却发现一张关于咖啡馆暂时停业的告示。
一辆汽车的刹车声吓了 Shiroya 一跳。当她走向路中间的那辆车时，发现 Atsuki 躺在地上。警察赶到现场后，强行把 Shiroya 带走了。
{u}2012年1月11日{/u}，Shiroya 被释放。她走回自己的公寓；她很久以前就听说过 12月15日发生的事：芦屋塔里没有发现任何活人。警察在一种无法辨认的气体中发现的全部，就是 Naomi Cabca 和 Isla Majutsu 的尸体。到了 1月，Sai Yomiya、Akaro Esata 和 Erina Majutsu 仍然下落不明。
袭击的余波使芦屋塔一直关闭，直到它被匿名买下。不久之后，官方宣布芦屋塔将被拆除。
10月4日 {time=12}，这座屹立已久的建筑倒塌了。一周后，在清理废墟时，那三名失踪者支离破碎的尸体在瓦砾深处被发现。
结局：遗弃接力

entries.text:
-Yushibana
I finally make the decision to do all I can to change the past. I decide that I will reenter the tower in two days and devise a proper plan to enact the following night.
Walking home, I once again notice someone following me. Before I can catch a glimpse of them, a police officer arrests them.
-Home
After eating, I stay in the living room until the sun begins to set.
-Yushibana
I leave my apartment before it's too dark and walk to our local lottery place, where I ask for the winning number on December 1st.
-Home
Reciting the numbers in my head, I make it back home and shortly fall asleep.
entries.new:
-丰花
我终于下定决心，要尽一切努力改变过去。我决定两天后重新进入那座塔，并制定一个合适的计划，在第二天夜里实施。
走回家的路上，我又注意到有人在跟踪我。还没等我看清对方，一名警察就逮捕了那个人。
-家
吃完饭后，我在客厅里待到太阳开始落山。
-丰花
趁天还没完全黑，我离开公寓，走到当地的彩票店，询问 12月1日的中奖号码。
-家
我在脑中默念着那些数字回到家，很快就睡着了。

entries.text:
-Home
I wake up when {u}my phone displays {time=9:57.}{/u} To use up the last minutes that I have, I do the laundry and step outside.
-Ina Café
I'm welcomed by Darfee, and I sit at a table with a cup of coffee.
entries.new:
-家
{u}我的手机显示 {time=9:57.}{/u} 时，我醒了。为了用完我剩下的最后几分钟，我洗了衣服，然后出门。
-伊娜咖啡馆
Darfree 欢迎了我，我端着一杯咖啡坐到桌边。

entries.text:
-Ina Café
The news on the TV says that a Xyn member was caught yesterday in Yushibana, and the screen shows an image very similar to what was in the newspaper.
I'm not able to put together a convincing theory regarding what happened, but the main takeaway is that the past was changed.
-Yushibana
I leave Ina, no longer afraid of changing history.
I decide to take Atsuki's tickets for the event, but after waiting near his house, I decide to go to Isla's first. As I'm knocking on her door, I accidentally open it and realize it isn't locked.
I find Isla's purse. Both tickets for December 15th are inside, so I quickly take them before stepping out.
-Home
I make it home and cook instant noodles. Lying on the carpet of my living room, the hours quickly pass.
entries.new:
-伊娜咖啡馆
电视新闻说，昨天有一名 Xyn 成员在丰花被抓，屏幕上显示的画面和报纸上的非常相似。
我无法对发生的事情拼凑出一个令人信服的理论，但重点是过去被改变了。
-丰花
我离开伊娜咖啡馆，不再害怕改变历史。
我决定拿走 Atsuki 的活动门票，但在他家附近等了一会儿后，我决定先去 Isla 家。我敲她家门时不小心把门打开了，这才发现门没有锁。
我找到了 Isla 的手提包。里面有两张 12月15日的门票，于是我迅速拿走它们，然后走了出去。
-家
我回到家，煮了方便面。躺在客厅的地毯上，几个小时很快就过去了。

entries.text:
-Living room
With all the thoughts running through my mind, I'm not able to fall asleep. After many hours on the carpet, I {u}look at my phone and see that it's {time=5:23.}{/u}
I decide to go to the tower before falling asleep in order to rest during the day and be awake the next night.
-Yushibana
I walk through the darkness until I arrive at Ashiya Tower. The entrance is closed, so I wait beside a streetlight.
The door never opens. After two hours of standing still, the sky, the tower, and the world remain unchanged.
I {u}look at my phone and read {time=7:35.}{/u} Realizing a potential way to enter the building, I step to its left wall in search of a hidden entrance. After shaking it, the door opens, and I find myself in the storeroom.
entries.new:
-客厅
满脑子思绪翻涌，我无法入睡。在地毯上待了许多个小时后，我{u}看了看手机，发现已经是 {time=5:23.}{/u}
我决定在睡着之前先去塔那边，这样白天可以休息，第二天夜里保持清醒。
-丰花
我穿过黑暗，来到芦屋塔。入口关着，所以我在一盏路灯旁等着。
门始终没有打开。一动不动地站了两个小时后，天空、塔和世界都没有任何变化。
我{u}看了看手机，看到时间是 {time=7:35.}{/u} 意识到可能有一种进入建筑的方法，我走到它左侧的墙边寻找暗门。摇过之后，门开了，我发现自己来到了储藏室。

entries.text:
-Crystal floor
I step into hallway A, filled with darkness and the same smell from the 15th. The security room is vacant, but I'm able to find the rusty key inside a drawer.
The breakers in the mechanical room are all turned on. Above them, I find the attic key and the Sekimeiya cabinet key.
-Event room
I make my way to the event room, which is colder than the rest of the building. The glass of the cabinet isn't firmly shut, and the Sekimeiya is behind it, next to a strange white substance.
I notice that the glass is cracked and stuck in place. Trying to scroll it down, I accidentally break it, triggering an alarm.
Beside the Sekimeiya, I find a card with the word "XYN" written on it. As I'm reaching my hand toward the Sekimeiya, I notice an immensely hot aura around it despite the cold of the cabinet.
entries.new:
-水晶层
我走进 A走廊，那里一片漆黑，还弥漫着 15日那股同样的气味。监控室里空无一人，但我在一个抽屉里找到了生锈的钥匙。
机械室里的断路器全都开着。在它们上方，我找到了阁楼钥匙和 Sekimeiya 展示柜的钥匙。
-活动室
我来到活动室，这里比建筑的其他地方更冷。展示柜的玻璃没有关严，Sekimeiya 就在玻璃后面，旁边有一种奇怪的白色物质。
我注意到玻璃裂了，而且卡在原位。我试着把它往下滑，却意外把它弄碎了，触发了警报。
在 Sekimeiya 旁边，我找到一张写有“XYN”字样的卡片。当我伸手去够 Sekimeiya 时，我注意到尽管展示柜很冷，它周围却环绕着一股极其灼热的光晕。

entries.text:
-Lobby
As soon as I touch the Sekimeiya, I find myself in the lobby with the same Atsuki from that day, who tells me he just appeared here as well. I quickly notice that my clothes are different and that I'm no longer tired.
-Hallway B
Lingering smoke is in the air, which makes us think we're at the {u}start of December 15th{/u}. After hearing a sound in the hallway, we're drawn to room B4.
-Crystal room B4
The cabinet where the Sekimeiya was first hidden on that day is set to 0ºC, and the temperature wheel is not broken. Atsuki lifts the cover, and we see the Sekimeiya inside the cabinet.
The Sekimeiya is burning hot, so we take it out of the cabinet and touch it, hoping to escape from the tower. When Atsuki makes contact with it, the Sekimeiya disappears, and I quickly realize that the cabinet closed without making a noise.
-Hallway B
We step out of the room when we hear someone running through the hallway. We can't see anyone, but we follow the steps up the tower.
-Floor 6
We hear the attic door being shut, and it's locked when we reach it. I look inside my purse and see that the attic key is still there.                   
-Attic
We unlock the attic and silently walk up the stairs. Through the gap of the door, I see Naomi in the living room.
entries.new:
-大厅
我一碰到 Sekimeiya，就发现自己身处大厅，和那天的 Atsuki 在一起。他告诉我他也是刚出现在这里。我很快注意到自己的衣服变了，而且不再疲惫。
-B走廊
空气中残留着烟雾，让我们觉得自己正处于{u}12月15日的开端{/u}。听到走廊里传来声音后，我们被吸引到了 B4 室。
-水晶展室 B4
那天最初藏匿 Sekimeiya 的展示柜设定为 0ºC，温度调节轮也没有损坏。Atsuki 掀开盖子，我们看到 Sekimeiya 就在展示柜里。
Sekimeiya 滚烫，所以我们把它从展示柜里取出来触摸它，希望能逃离这座塔。当 Atsuki 碰到它时，Sekimeiya 消失了，我很快意识到展示柜在没发出任何声音的情况下关上了。
-B走廊
我们听到有人跑过走廊，便走出房间。我们看不到任何人，但跟着脚步声往塔上走。
-六楼
我们听到阁楼门被关上，等我们到达时，门已经锁了。我看了一眼自己的手提包，发现阁楼钥匙还在里面。
-阁楼
我们打开阁楼的锁，悄悄走上楼梯。透过门缝，我看到 Naomi 在客厅里。

entries.text:
-Attic
I can't find Atsuki behind me. I walk down the stairs and find that the attic door is locked again.
-Crystal floor
Watching from hallway C, I witness the start of that long day unfold. Both groups meet each other, but Katei doesn't seem to be there.
-Attic's living room
Naomi is not in the living room anymore, but a suitcase is opened up on the sofa. Inside it are two Sekimeiya, one of which is gray.
-Right bedroom
I put on clothes from the wardrobe and hide the Sekimeiya under the bed.
entries.new:
-阁楼
我找不到身后的 Atsuki。我走下楼梯，发现阁楼门又锁上了。
-水晶层
我从 C走廊观望，目睹那个漫长一天的开端展开。两组人相遇了，但 Katei 似乎不在那里。
-阁楼的客厅
Naomi 已经不在客厅里了，但沙发上有一个打开的手提箱。里面有两个 Sekimeiya，其中一个是灰色的。
-右侧卧室
我穿上衣柜里的衣服，把 Sekimeiya 藏在床下。

entries.text:
-Crystal floor
I hide in room A5 and listen to the group going up the floors. I attempt to open the security room, but it's locked. I circle around the floor and am unable to find Atsuki.                   
-Storeroom
The handle of the hidden door is attached. I use it to open the door, which lets me see the white morning sky.                    
-Event room
A distant yell brings me to the event room, where I find my own body lying on the floor next to Naomi's.
-Storeroom
Back in the storeroom, I'm able to indistinctly hear the others. They don't find the bodies or the Sekimeiya in the event room and proceed to search for the missing people through the building.
I listen to the disorder outside the storeroom. After Akaro finds the Sekimeiya on the fourth floor, Atsuki refuses to stay put anywhere until I'm found. That compels me to step out of the storeroom and show myself to them.
-Crystal floor
I notice that the elevator panel was taken off. When the group sees me, I lie and say that Naomi locked herself up in the attic after handing me different clothes. I'm told that she asked to talk to me and Akaro privately before the three of us walked to the crystal floor.
entries.new:
-水晶层
我躲在 A5 室里，听着那群人上楼。我试着打开监控室，但它锁着。我在这一层绕了一圈，没能找到 Atsuki。
-储藏室
暗门的把手装好了。我用它打开了门，这让我看到了清晨白色的天空。
-活动室
远处的一声喊叫把我引到活动室，我在那里发现自己的尸体躺在 Naomi 的尸体旁边。
-储藏室
回到储藏室后，我隐约能听到其他人的声音。他们在活动室里没有找到尸体或 Sekimeiya，于是继续在整栋建筑里寻找失踪的人。
我听着储藏室外的混乱动静。Akaro 在四楼找到 Sekimeiya 后，Atsuki 拒绝待在任何一个地方，直到我被找到。这促使我走出储藏室，向他们现身。
-水晶层
我注意到电梯面板被拆掉了。当那群人看到我时，我撒谎说 Naomi 把不同的衣服交给我后，就把自己锁在了阁楼里。我被告知，她曾要求在三个人一起走到水晶层之前，先和我以及 Akaro 私下谈谈。

entries.text:
-Crystal room B4
Akaro suggests we stay in room B4 due to its temperature regulation cabinets. He puts the Sekimeiya into a cold one and sits next to me.  
Around two hours later, Sai leaves the room and doesn't come back. A while later, we begin to hear faint sounds beyond the room.
Erina goes to the bathroom. She doesn't come back either.
-Lobby
I leave the room and am drawn to the open lobby. Next to the hallway A door, both my own body and Naomi's are lying down next to a pool of blood.
-Crystal floor
Erina's corpse is in front of the staircase. I realize that Atsuki and Akaro left room B4 and hide in the women's bathroom.
-Women's bathroom
Minutes pass as the crystal floor remains silent.
entries.new:
-水晶展室 B4
Akaro 建议我们待在 B4 室，因为那里的展示柜可以调节温度。他把 Sekimeiya 放进一个冰冷的展示柜里，然后坐到我旁边。
大约两个小时后，Sai 离开了房间，没有再回来。又过了一会儿，我们开始听到房间外传来微弱的声音。
Erina 去了卫生间。她也没有回来。
-大厅
我离开房间，被吸引到敞开的大厅。在 A走廊门旁，我自己的尸体和 Naomi 的尸体都躺在一滩血旁边。
-水晶层
Erina 的尸体在楼梯前。我意识到 Atsuki 和 Akaro 离开了 B4 室，于是躲进女卫生间。
-女卫生间
几分钟过去了，水晶层一直很安静。

entries.text:
-Crystal room B4
Room B4 is empty, and the cabinet with the Sekimeiya is open.
-Lobby
As I'm bringing the Sekimeiya to the storeroom, I notice that Naomi's body has vanished from the lobby.
-Storeroom
I leave the Sekimeiya on the floor of the hidden passage as soon as an essential piece of the puzzle appears in my head.
-Floor 2
I run up, estimating it must be around {time=15.} In front of the door to the partitions, I find a Sekimeiya. It's very hot, but I'm able to bring it with me thanks to the thick clothes from the attic.
-Attic
I see Atsuki crying on a bed. Having failed to find Akaro and Isla confirms my belief.
-Storeroom
I return to the storeroom and place the Sekimeiya on the floor. As soon as I touch the one I obtained in room B4, both of them disappear.
I dash over and confirm that the door in the back of the corridor no longer has a handle.
entries.new:
-水晶展室 B4
B4 室里空无一人，装着 Sekimeiya 的展示柜开着。
-大厅
当我把 Sekimeiya 带去储藏室时，我注意到 Naomi 的尸体已经从大厅消失了。
-储藏室
脑中刚一浮现出谜题的关键一环，我就把 Sekimeiya 留在了暗道的地上。
-二楼
我跑上楼，估计现在大约是 {time=15.} 在隔间门前，我找到了一个 Sekimeiya。它非常烫，但多亏从阁楼拿来的厚衣服，我才能把它带走。
-阁楼
我看到 Atsuki 在床上哭泣。我没能找到 Akaro 和 Isla，这证实了我的想法。
-储藏室
我回到储藏室，把 Sekimeiya 放在地上。我刚一碰到在 B4 室得到的那个 Sekimeiya，两个就都消失了。
我冲过去，确认走廊尽头的那扇门已经没有把手了。

entries.text:
-Storeroom
Minutes of silence pass while I'm in the storeroom.
-Attic
To confirm that I'm back in my world, I go to the attic. I can't find Isla, so I wait in the attic's storeroom for someone to leave the right bedroom, which our past selves must be locked inside.
I finally hear sounds in the hallway. Once they fade, I step out and call the elevator, causing a dilemma to instantly arise in my mind.
-Storeroom
Back on the crystal floor, I hide in the storeroom and pay attention to the sounds outside. I perceive what must be our past selves, but not everything I expect to hear.
-Lobby
The lobby is empty, and my corpse has been replaced with a single drop of blood.
-Event room
The cabinet is empty.
-Crystal room B6
The open door lures me to room B6, where a Sekimeiya is on the floor near the door. I take it with me.
-Crystal room B4
Naomi is under a curtain, and the wheel of the cabinet from this morning is damaged.
Erina suddenly enters the room and collapses on the floor. She's soaked in blood, but I recall that she's not dead.
I wait until our past selves come in and find Erina.
entries.new:
-储藏室
我在储藏室里度过了几分钟的寂静。
-阁楼
为了确认自己回到了我的世界，我去了阁楼。我找不到 Isla，于是在阁楼的储藏室里等着，等有人从右侧卧室出来——我们过去的自己一定被锁在里面。
我终于听到走廊里有声音。等声音消失后，我走出去叫了电梯，这让我脑中立刻出现了一个两难局面。
-储藏室
回到水晶层后，我躲在储藏室里，注意听着外面的声音。我辨认出那一定是我们过去的自己，但听到的并不全是我预期中的内容。
-大厅
大厅里空无一人，我的尸体被换成了一滴血。
-活动室
展示柜是空的。
-水晶展室 B6
敞开的门把我引到 B6 室，那里门附近的地上有一个 Sekimeiya。我把它带走了。
-水晶展室 B4
Naomi 在帘子下面，而今天早上那个展示柜的轮子已经损坏了。
Erina 突然走进房间，倒在地上。她浑身是血，但我记得她并没有死。
我一直等到我们过去的自己进来并发现 Erina。

entries.text:
-Hallway B
The moment I step out, Atsuki sees me from the event room. I keep walking to hallway C to reach the storeroom.
-Storeroom
I wait until our past selves go to the attic.
-Crystal room B4
I pick up the Sekimeiya on the floor.
-Crystal floor
As I'm going back to the storeroom, I find Sai coming out of it. I retreat to the lobby before he sees me, and I circle back to hallway C.
-Cleaning room
I hear a noise in hallway B and quickly hide in the cleaning room.
I wait until our past selves return to the event room after being chased by Sai.
-Crystal floor
Looking from hallway C, I learn the way Sai avoided being found in hallway B.
-Storeroom
I wait until my past self travels to the attic's bedroom with Sai.
entries.new:
-B走廊
我一走出去，Atsuki 就从活动室看到了我。我继续走向 C走廊，以便到达储藏室。
-储藏室
我一直等到我们过去的自己去了阁楼。
-水晶展室 B4
我捡起地上的 Sekimeiya。
-水晶层
当我回储藏室时，我发现 Sai 正从里面出来。我在他看见我之前退回大厅，然后绕回 C走廊。
-清洁间
我听到 B走廊里有动静，便迅速躲进清洁间。
我一直等到我们过去的自己被 Sai 追赶后回到活动室。
-水晶层
从 C走廊观察，我弄清了 Sai 是如何在 B走廊里避免被发现的。
-储藏室
我一直等到过去的自己和 Sai 一起前往阁楼的卧室。

entries.text:
-Event room
The event room is empty.
-Crystal room B4
I put the Sekimeiya into a cold cabinet and wait by the door.
-Lobby
I feel as if I hear a sound from the lobby, but I can't see anyone when I open the door. From there, I clearly hear someone in hallway A and immediately in hallway B as well.
Atsuki's piercing yells suddenly reach my ears.
-Hallway B
Atsuki warily walks to me. Before I can explain myself, Erina arrives from hallway C.
entries.new:
-活动室
活动室是空的。
-水晶展室 B4
我把 Sekimeiya 放进一个冰冷的展示柜，然后在门边等着。
-大厅
我好像听到大厅传来声音，但当我打开门时，却看不到任何人。从那里，我清楚地听到 A走廊里有人，紧接着 B走廊里也有人。
Atsuki 刺耳的喊声突然传到我耳中。
-B走廊
Atsuki 警惕地朝我走来。还没等我解释，Erina 就从 C走廊过来了。

entries.text:
-Event room
We follow Erina to the event room and find the Sekimeiya in the cabinet. Erina rolls it into her purse.
Sai appears from hallway A.
Erina gives a note to Atsuki, which he quickly pockets.
Erina claims to have seen Miiya.
After approximately fifteen minutes of charge, Erina activates the Sekimeiya. Sai is the only person to disappear. The Sekimeiya vanishes from Erina's purse and seems to reappear in the cabinet.
-Hallway B
Atsuki goes to the staff room, but he can't find a Sekimeiya inside it.
Sai appears from the lobby and Akaro from the event room. Both of them are taken aback by my presence. {u}Sai's wristwatch displays {time=18:43.}{/u}
I look around me and notice that the camera closest to the lobby has a clean lens. I ask the others not to follow me and run to the elevator in order to reach the attic.
-Attic's living room
Atsuki appears from the staircase and tells me that I traveled to the future instead of the past.
entries.new:
-活动室
我们跟着 Erina 来到活动室，在展示柜里找到了 Sekimeiya。Erina 把它卷进了自己的手提包。
Sai 从 A走廊出现。
Erina 把一张纸条交给 Atsuki，他迅速把它塞进口袋。
Erina 声称自己看到了 Miiya。
大约充能十五分钟后，Erina 启动了 Sekimeiya。只有 Sai 消失了。Sekimeiya 从 Erina 的手提包里消失，似乎又出现在了展示柜里。
-B走廊
Atsuki 去了员工室，但他在里面找不到 Sekimeiya。
Sai 从大厅出现，Akaro 从活动室出现。两人都被我的出现吓了一跳。{u}Sai 的手表显示 {time=18:43.}{/u}
我环顾四周，注意到离大厅最近的摄像头镜头很干净。我让其他人不要跟着我，然后跑向电梯，以便到达阁楼。
-阁楼的客厅
Atsuki 从楼梯出现，告诉我我穿越到了未来，而不是过去。

entries.text:
-Ashiya Tower
While Atsuki is crying on a bed, Sai steps out of room B6, confused—the Sekimeiya disappeared without him having touched them.
As he looks through the crystal floor, he realizes it's not the place he's familiar with. The corpses he knew of have vanished, and others have appeared.
The moment Sai shows himself to Atsuki, he is welcomed by a sudden blow that comes close to ending his life. Wielding a knife, he retaliates and chases Atsuki.
Sai comes across a locked bathroom on floor 6, where Atsuki must've hidden. Aware of the location of two Sekimeiya, Sai runs to the crystal floor.
Many hours later, Atsuki is still locked up inside that bathroom. When he steps out of it, nobody is in sight.
On the crystal floor, Atsuki is drawn to the storeroom, where a glowing Sekimeiya lies in the dark. After touching it, it disappears.
Near the stairs, Erina's corpse is no longer there. When Atsuki enters the event room, he finds the Sekimeiya on the floor. Once again, the instant he touches it, it disappears.
Atsuki notices that the panel next to the elevator is properly attached and uses it to call the elevator.
{u}At {time=21:04}{/u}, the police enter the building and find the corpses of Shiroya Mirana in the lobby, Erina Majutsu near the staircase, and Sai Yomiya split in half in hallway B. The Sekimeiya cabinet is empty, but two Sekimeiya are shortly found and placed inside it.
Trying to find the missing people, a police officer inspects the elevator shaft, where Atsuki's unconscious body is found. He's taken to safety, but his account of events quickly begins to be questioned.
Many weeks after December 15th, almost a third of Japan's population disappears forever.
entries.new:
-芦屋塔
当 Atsuki 在床上哭泣时，Sai 困惑地从 B6 室走出来——Sekimeiya 在他没有触碰的情况下消失了。
当他查看水晶层时，他意识到这里不是他熟悉的地方。他认识的尸体消失了，而其他尸体出现了。
Sai 一出现在 Atsuki 面前，就迎面遭到一记几乎要了他命的突然袭击。他挥着刀反击，并追赶 Atsuki。
Sai 在六楼遇到一间锁着的卫生间，Atsuki 一定躲在那里。Sai 知道两个 Sekimeiya 的位置，便跑向水晶层。
许多个小时后，Atsuki 仍被锁在那间卫生间里。当他走出来时，看不到任何人。
在水晶层，Atsuki 被吸引到储藏室，那里黑暗中有个发光的 Sekimeiya。触碰之后，它消失了。
在楼梯附近，Erina 的尸体已经不在了。当 Atsuki 进入活动室时，他发现 Sekimeiya 在地上。他刚一碰到它，它又一次消失了。
Atsuki 注意到电梯旁的面板完好地装在上面，便用它叫了电梯。
{u}到了 {time=21:04}{/u}，警察进入建筑，在大厅发现了 Shiroya Mirana 的尸体，在楼梯附近发现了 Erina Majutsu 的尸体，并在 B走廊发现了被劈成两半的 Sai Yomiya。Sekimeiya 展示柜是空的，但很快又找到了两个 Sekimeiya，并把它们放了进去。
为了寻找失踪的人，一名警察检查了电梯井，并在那里发现了昏迷的 Atsuki。他被带到了安全的地方，但他对事件的描述很快开始受到质疑。
12月15日过去许多周后，日本近三分之一的人口永远消失了。

entries.text:
-Yushibana
On {u}November 27th{/u}, Gan, an owner of a gem shop, finds a peculiar gemstone on an unexplored mountain. Once he brings it home, he calls Ashiya with hopes of selling the discovery to them.
He quickly finds out that the gem becomes hot indoors and fears Ashiya will refuse a deal due to that.
The next day, when one of Ashiya's representatives visits the shop, Gan warns him to always keep the gemstone, named "Sekimeiya", cold.
On {u}November 29th{/u}, Gan returns to the place where he found the gemstone and finds an identical one. Back home, he calls Ashiya again, and they are also willing to take the second one despite the Sekimeiya having already been announced for showing on the 15th of December.
entries.new:
-丰花
{u}11月27日{/u}，宝石店老板 Gan 在一座未勘探的山上发现了一颗奇特的宝石。他把宝石带回家后，打电话给芦屋，希望把这一发现卖给他们。
他很快发现这颗宝石在室内会变热，并担心芦屋会因此拒绝交易。
第二天，当芦屋的一名代表来到店里时，Gan 警告他要始终让这颗名为“Sekimeiya”的宝石保持低温。
{u}11月29日{/u}，Gan 回到他发现宝石的地方，又找到了一颗一模一样的宝石。回到家后，他再次打电话给芦屋，而尽管 Sekimeiya 已经宣布将于 12月15日展出，他们也愿意收下第二颗。

entries.text:
-Town
In a mansion on the outskirts of a small town, Kyuuka, a young boy who distanced himself from the world, finally decides to act against the malice of his older brother.
entries.new:
-小镇
在一座小镇郊外的宅邸里，Kyuuka——一个与世隔绝的少年——终于决定反抗他哥哥的恶意。

entries.text:
-Ashiya Tower
In the security room, Katei sends himself a video recording.
-Katei's apartment
Katei watches the video at home. In it, he sees Ido, the janitor of Ashiya Tower, walking through hallway A during the time period from which footage was erased.    
-Yushibana
Early in the morning, Katei calls Lei and meets with her outside Ashiya Tower.
Katei presents Lei with his plan to catch Xyn.
-Ashiya Tower
Before Katei's shift begins, he daydreams about his true intentions.
-Katei's apartment
The next day, Katei steps out of his apartment with something he's finally taken out of his drawer.
-Ashiya Tower
Katei sneaks in a spying bug and a playback device through the storeroom, and he places the bug on Ido's clothes.
Three days later, on Monday 28th, the bug hasn't recorded anything of importance. To make sure that Ido is the mole, Katei talks to him and gives him information valuable to Xyn.
entries.new:
-芦屋塔
在监控室里，Katei 给自己发送了一段录像。
-Katei 的公寓
Katei 在家观看录像。在录像中，他看到了芦屋塔的清洁工 Ido 在录像被删除的那段时间里穿过 A走廊。
-丰花
清晨，Katei 打电话给 Lei，并在芦屋塔外与她见面。
Katei 向 Lei 展示了他抓住 Xyn 的计划。
-芦屋塔
在 Katei 的轮班开始前，他幻想着自己的真实意图。
-Katei 的公寓
第二天，Katei 带着他终于从抽屉里取出的某样东西走出了公寓。
-芦屋塔
Katei 通过储藏室偷偷带进了一个窃听器和一台播放设备，并把窃听器放到了 Ido 的衣服上。
三天后，也就是 28日星期一，窃听器没有录到任何重要的内容。为了确认 Ido 就是内鬼，Katei 和他交谈，并给了他一些对 Xyn 有价值的信息。

entries.text:
-???
Atase is summoned by his boss. During their talk, Ido walks in and reports the information he was given by Katei. 
-Ashiya Tower
The next day, November 29th, Katei listens to Xyn's conversation. Once it ends, Lei lets him know that the primary announcements of the Sekimeiya have been made.
-???
Atase is summoned by his boss again. After the public announcement, Xyn designs a plan to obtain the Sekimeiya before Ashiya.
-Yushibana
On {u}November 30th at almost {time=21}{/u}, Atase enters Musashi Gemstones. After the owner of the shop hands him a box with a gemstone inside, Atase sets off a smoke grenade and runs out, quickly escaping by car.
At {time=21}, Lei enters Musashi Gemstones. Taken aback by the darkness, she turns the lights off and on, causing an explosion in the back of the shop.
Atase and Faiten are pulled over by the police due to their reckless driving. Before they're let free, the officer is told the information Lei explained to the police about the recent attack. The officer retrieves the box, but Atase and Faiten are able to escape.
Late in the night, a forensic group is at the tunnel under Musashi Gemstones. During the explosion, one of the Sekimeiya fell through the floor alongside Shiroya Mirana, who entered a coma. Miiya Moiromo's body wasn't found in one piece, but she was confirmed to have died instantly. Atsuki Hakutoki and the owner of the shop, the last two people to have inhaled the smoke, were sent to the hospital in stable condition.
-???
When Atase and Faiten meet up with their boss, they're told that a girl died in the gem shop after their attack.
-Atase's apartment
At home, Atase reads the report of the girl's death. Ashiya and Xyn aren't mentioned in the article.
entries.new:
-???
Atase 被老板叫去。在他们谈话期间，Ido 走进来，报告了 Katei 给他的信息。
-芦屋塔
第二天，11月29日，Katei 偷听 Xyn 的谈话。谈话结束后，Lei 让他知道 Sekimeiya 的主要公告已经发布。
-???
Atase 再次被老板叫去。公开公告之后，Xyn 制定了一个计划，要在芦屋之前得到 Sekimeiya。
-丰花
{u}11月30日将近 {time=21}{/u} 时，Atase 进入武藏宝石。店主递给他一个装有宝石的盒子后，Atase 引爆了一枚烟雾弹，跑出去，迅速乘车逃离。
{time=21} 时，Lei 进入武藏宝石。她被黑暗吓了一跳，把灯关掉又打开，结果店后发生了爆炸。
Atase 和 Faiten 因鲁莽驾驶被警察拦下。在他们被放走之前，警察得知了 Lei 向警方解释的关于最近袭击的信息。警察取回了盒子，但 Atase 和 Faiten 得以逃脱。
深夜，一个鉴证小组来到武藏宝石下方的隧道。爆炸期间，其中一个 Sekimeiya 和 Shiroya Mirana 一起穿过了地板，Shiroya 陷入了昏迷。Miiya Moiromo 的尸体被发现时并不完整，但确认她当场死亡。最后两个吸入烟雾的人——Atsuki Hakutoki 和店主——被送往医院，情况稳定。
-???
当 Atase 和 Faiten 与老板会合时，他们被告知在他们袭击之后，有一个女孩死在了宝石店里。
-Atase 的公寓
在家时，Atase 读了那个女孩死亡的报道。文章中既没有提到芦屋，也没有提到 Xyn。

entries.text:
-???
The next day, Atase, Ido, and their boss craft a plan to take advantage of Ashiya's event and steal the Sekimeiya.
-Ashiya Tower
Katei listens to Xyn's plan and thinks of a way to outsmart them.
-Yushibana
Calm days pass until December 15th, during which Xyn and Katei work hard to perfect their respective plans.
entries.new:
-???
第二天，Atase、Ido 和他们的老板制定了一个计划，想利用芦屋的活动偷走 Sekimeiya。
-芦屋塔
Katei 偷听了 Xyn 的计划，并想出了智取他们的办法。
-丰花
平静的日子一直持续到 12月15日，在此期间，Xyn 和 Katei 都在努力完善各自的计划。

entries.text:
-Ashiya Tower
Atase is the first visitor to enter the tower. Before {time=9}, he realizes that the boy next to him is someone who was in the gem shop during Xyn's attack.
-Event room
The first group is taken to the event room. Before the cabinet's curtain is raised, the grenade in Atase's pocket puts everyone but him to sleep.
-Cleaning room
Atase obtains the fake Sekimeiya in the cleaning cart.
-Event room
Two Sekimeiya are inside the cabinet. Severely confused, Atase is only able to replace one.
-Cleaning room
Atase puts a real Sekimeiya inside the cleaning cart.
-Event room
Atase returns to the event room and lies down, faking his unconsciousness.
entries.new:
-芦屋塔
Atase 是第一个进入塔的访客。在 {time=9} 之前，他意识到身旁的男孩是 Xyn 袭击期间曾在宝石店里的那个人。
-活动室
第一批人被带到活动室。展示柜的帘子升起之前，Atase 口袋里的手榴弹让除他以外的所有人都睡着了。
-清洁间
Atase 在清洁车里拿到了赝品 Sekimeiya。
-活动室
展示柜里有两个 Sekimeiya。Atase 非常困惑，只能替换掉其中一个。
-清洁间
Atase 把一个真正的 Sekimeiya 放进了清洁车里。
-活动室
Atase 回到活动室躺下，假装自己失去了意识。

entries.text:
-Ashiya Tower
When the first group is brought to the event room, Katei steps out of the security room and walks to the lobby.
The smoke is released in the hallways, making everyone hurriedly evacuate. Katei uses that moment to reenter hallway A and crawls to avoid inhaling too much of the smoke.
From the hallway, Katei sees which of the two Sekimeiya Atase replaces. When Atase returns to the cleaning room, Katei takes the real Sekimeiya from the cabinet.
Katei takes the other real Sekimeiya from the cleaning cart and brings them to the security room's secret corridor, where he puts them in a suitcase he had left there.
As he's about to unlock the secret exit, Katei realizes he dropped the key while he was crawling. He returns to hallway A and is able to find it near the event room.
Even with the key, Katei isn't able to unlock the door in the storeroom. After lamenting his defeat, he realizes the suitcase with the Sekimeiya has disappeared.
Katei chases a sound out of the storeroom. In hallway A, he sees Naomi with the suitcase and chases after her.
Running up the floors, Katei trips on the third set of stairs. Realizing that he will be unable to enter the attic, he returns to the crystal floor to assess the situation.
entries.new:
-芦屋塔
当第一批人被带到活动室时，Katei 走出监控室，走向大厅。
走廊里释放了烟雾，迫使所有人匆忙撤离。Katei 利用那一刻重新进入 A走廊，并爬行以避免吸入过多烟雾。
从走廊里，Katei 看清了 Atase 替换了两个 Sekimeiya 中的哪一个。当 Atase 回到清洁间时，Katei 从展示柜里拿走了真正的 Sekimeiya。
Katei 从清洁车里拿走另一个真正的 Sekimeiya，把它们带到监控室的秘密走廊，放进他留在那里的一个手提箱里。
就在他准备打开秘密出口时，Katei 意识到自己在爬行时把钥匙掉了。他回到 A走廊，在活动室附近找到了它。
即使有钥匙，Katei 也没能打开储藏室里的门。在哀叹自己的失败后，他意识到装 Sekimeiya 的手提箱不见了。
Katei 追着一个声音离开储藏室。在 A走廊，他看到 Naomi 拿着手提箱，便追了上去。
往楼上跑时，Katei 在第三段楼梯上绊倒了。意识到自己无法进入阁楼后，他回到水晶层评估情况。

entries.text:
-Event room
Naomi is woken up by the sound of footsteps.
-Ashiya Tower
Naomi is drawn to the storeroom. After Katei steps out of it, Naomi walks in and sees the secret corridor. On the floor, she finds a suitcase with two Sekimeiya inside, and she takes it with her.
Naomi sees Katei reentering the storeroom. As she's getting closer to the lobby, she hears someone running behind her.
In the lobby, Naomi sees a shutter blocking the exit. She bolts to hallway B with the suitcase and runs up the floors until she locks herself up in the attic.
-Attic
Naomi opens up the suitcase on the sofa and realizes that its interior is hot.
When she feels the surface of a Sekimeiya, both gemstones disappear. Her keys, which she'd left next to the suitcase, seem to have vanished too.
Unable to unlock the exit, Naomi attempts to call the elevator, but it doesn't come. Out of nowhere, she finds herself trapped there.
entries.new:
-活动室
Naomi 被脚步声吵醒。
-芦屋塔
Naomi 被吸引到储藏室。Katei 从里面走出来后，Naomi 走了进去，看到了秘密走廊。她在地板上找到一个装有两个 Sekimeiya 的手提箱，便把它带走了。
Naomi 看到 Katei 重新进入储藏室。当她越来越接近大厅时，她听到身后有人在跑。
在大厅里，Naomi 看到一扇卷帘门挡住了出口。她带着手提箱冲向 B走廊，一路往楼上跑，直到把自己锁进阁楼。
-阁楼
Naomi 在沙发上打开手提箱，发现里面很热。
当她触摸到一个 Sekimeiya 的表面时，两颗宝石都消失了。她留在手提箱旁边的钥匙似乎也不见了。
Naomi 无法打开出口，便试着叫电梯，但电梯没有来。不知不觉间，她发现自己被困在了那里。

entries.text:
-Ashiya Tower
Erina notices that Isla's corpse is no longer in room A5.
We find Akaro, who tells us he just used the Sekimeiya after escaping the attic's bedroom with Sai.
Every floor is dark, but we can power on a lamp in the attic. Akaro's clothes and hairstyle are different, and Erina's fingertip is bleeding.
An empty glass in the kitchen makes me think that we might've traveled far to the future.
entries.new:
-芦屋塔
Erina 注意到 Isla 的尸体已经不在 A5 室里了。
我们找到了 Akaro，他告诉我们，他和 Sai 逃出阁楼的卧室后刚使用过 Sekimeiya。
每一层都很黑，但我们能在阁楼点亮一盏灯。Akaro 的衣服和发型都变了，Erina 的指尖在流血。
厨房里的一个空玻璃杯让我觉得，我们可能穿越到了很远的未来。

entries.text:
-Ashiya Tower
Isla appears while we're in the right bedroom. The conversation we heard in the recording takes place.
{u}Isla tells us it's January 5th, 2012{/u}. When she says she entered through the storeroom, everyone runs down to check if the door is still open.
I realize that the alarm must've been recently triggered again and that someone was in the event room minutes ago. I wait 25 minutes and activate the Sekimeiya.
I appear in the dark lobby before the shutter is activated. The alarm is suddenly triggered, and as I'm about to escape through the storeroom, I teleport back to the lobby.

-Lobby
The lights are on, and the shutter is in place. Shiroya and I realize we traveled to the start of the incident when we see the unconscious second group in hallway B and the smoke in the air.
-Crystal room B4
The cabinet where the Sekimeiya was first hidden on that day is set to 0ºC, and the temperature wheel is not broken. I lift the cover, and we see the Sekimeiya inside the cabinet.
The Sekimeiya is burning hot, so we take it out of the cabinet and touch it, hoping to escape from the tower. When I make contact with it, the Sekimeiya disappears, and Shiroya soon notices that the cabinet closed without making a noise.
-Hallway B
We step out of the room when we hear someone running through the hallway. We can't see anyone, but we follow the steps up the tower.
-Floor 6
We hear the attic door being shut, and it's locked when we reach it. Shiroya takes out the attic key from her purse and unlocks the door.
-Attic
After Shiroya peeks into the living room, she disappears.

-Attic
Two Sekimeiya are on the sofa of the living room, one of which is white. Next to them is Naomi's keyring.
-Storeroom
I run back down, realizing I might be able to escape through the storeroom. The secret door has a handle, but it's locked.
-Hallway A
I'm unable to find the rusty key where we found it before.
-Storeroom
I listen to the group's movements, which reveal that everything is happening differently from what we lived through.
-Security room
I go to the security room when nobody can see me. It's unlocked, and all the screens are turned off. I find the rusty key in one of the drawers.
-Storeroom
Even with the key, I'm not able to open the secret door.

-Storeroom
I spend a long time hidden in the storeroom, sporadically hearing people. I'm drawn out when I hear Miiya's voice.
-Crystal floor
The group is going up the stairs. As I'm trying to spot Miiya, Sai turns around and sees the open storeroom.
They find the storeroom's secret. Watching from afar, I'm unable to see my other self, Miiya, or Shiroya.
-Event room
As I'm waiting for the group to leave, I hear someone walking in hallway A who might've come from a room to my left.
-Crystal room A1
After the group has left the storeroom, I go to room A1, where I feel someone might've been despite the crystal floor having been recently searched. I find a Sekimeiya in one of the cabinets, but it doesn't work.
-Men's bathroom (Floor 2)
I wait in a bathroom on the second floor until Sai comes down alone. He seems to be searching through the crystal floor. I keep hiding until the group walks back down. 
-Floor 2
I make out that Katei found a Sekimeiya in hallway B. After a sharp sound coming from there, I'm unable to hear anyone else.

-Crystal floor
A white Sekimeiya is on the floor of hallway B, near the event room. It's really hot.
-Event room
In the event room is a gray Sekimeiya, near hallway B.
-Crystal room A1
A third and cold Sekimeiya is still inside a cabinet.
-Attic
I bring the two functional Sekimeiya to the attic and theorize about the world I'm in.
With the voice recorder and the kitchen's refrigerator, I figure out many of the Sekimeiya's secrets through repeated tests.
I go through the events of December 15th, trying to uncover all the mysteries that surrounded us.
When the recorder reads 65:19, I touch the Past Sekimeiya with a full loop in mind.

-Ashiya Tower
I appear in the lobby of Ashiya Tower as desired. There's no shutter, and I'm in possession of both Sekimeiya.
-Yushibana
I unlock the exit with one of the keys I appeared with. With the Sekimeiya in a suitcase, I walk through the night streets of Yushibana.
-Eagle Hostel
{u}A digital clock displays {time=22:54} on November 24th{/u}.
-Home
I touch the Sekimeiya to duplicate the money, but I appear in my own house, wearing different clothes.
-Eagle Hostel
I put both Sekimeiya in the refrigerator and successfully duplicate the money.
I wake up on {u}November 25th{/u} and go over my plan.

-Yushibana
The days pass until December 1st. Atsuki runs to the cafeteria early in the morning, but he fails to see the news of the explosion being televised.
Atsuki runs to Musashi Gemstones and sees that the floor is intact—the accident didn't take place, and the Sekimeiya discovery hasn't been announced. Later that day, he sees Miiya, Shiroya, and his own self meeting up in Seeuta D'ella park.
Ending: Impossible Perfection

-Eagle Hostel
I realize that I never truly changed the past, and a test convinces me it's not possible.
On {u}November 28th{/u}, the possibility that the Sekimeiya weren't found arises in my head. After devising a plan to solve the issue, I open the refrigerator and only find the Past Sekimeiya.
-Yushibana
I go to the secret field on Airun, where Shiroya and I used to play as kids.
When the Sekimeiya has gathered energy inside the suitcase for forty minutes, I activate it, leaving it there as I appear in the hostel's bedroom.
-Eagle Hostel
I appear at {u}{time=7:01} on November 27th{/u}, when my past self is deeply asleep.
-Yushibana
I take the Future Sekimeiya to Airun and leave it on the snowy grass. Late in the day, the owner of Musashi Gemstones finds it.

-Eagle Hostel
I return to the hostel. On {u}November 30th{/u}, I don't leave the bedroom once.
On {u}December 1st{/u}, the news shows that the explosion still happened.
-Yushibana
I step out of the hostel on {u}December 9th{/u}, a Friday.
-Ashiya Tower
I buy an entry pass to the first floor halls. A "Forbidden Entry" sign is on the door to the event room. The secret door in the storeroom has a handle, and I'm able to unlock it with the rusty key.
As I'm leaving, I have a conversation with the receptionist that throws me off, making me become aware of my mistake.

-Yushibana
On {u}December 15th{/u}, I step out of the hostel with a USB device and duct tape.
-Ashiya Tower
I enter the tower early in the morning through the storeroom. With the duct tape, I cover a camera in hallway B. I make it to the security room before the smoke is released. I can see Miiya through the monitors.
After the smoke is released, I uncover the camera and record Akaro and Katei's secret movements. I save the recording on the USB drive and leave the room before Katei can see me.
I follow behind the group to learn their movements.
Miiya sees me from the event room, and I have to act as the Atsuki from this world until he returns with Sai.
A long time passes while Akaro and Sai repeatedly find and hide the Sekimeiya.
The other Atsuki and Miiya return from the attic. I hide in room A1 so that I'm not seen, and I hear Suripo's voice from inside. A while later, the group finds him dead in the lobby.
The group begins to search through the building. When my other self enters room A1, I tell him to stay there while I search through the other rooms, not revealing all the Sekimeiya. Miiya and I search through the other floors and can't find anyone. Meanwhile, the group finds the storeroom's secret after my past self leaves it.
When we return to the crystal floor, Miiya goes to the storeroom and is eventually joined by my other self. The entire group goes to the attic and eventually disappears from the building, leaving my past self experimenting with the Sekimeiya.

-???
The true shape of the labyrinth is revealed.

-Ashiya Tower
Everyone returns when {u}I approximate it's a little past {time=16.}{/u} The others stay on the crystal floor, so I go to the attic.
-Floor 6
Through various thought-up loop attempts, I finally come to an answer for my final dilemma.
-Attic
{u}At an estimated {time=18:30}{/u}, I take both Sekimeiya out of the refrigerator and start a new recording.
-Floor 6
I accidentally run into Miiya and the Atsuki from this world. I give them the Future Sekimeiya and tell them that everything will be okay if they follow my instructions.
-Attic
After they leave, the elevator goes to the attic. I follow it and reunite with Shiroya in the living room. I explain the plan to her in order to save Miiya.
-Floor 4
After Shiroya disappears, I find her in the third partition of the fourth floor. Both of us return to our world.
-Mechanical Room
I leave the USB recording on the computer before we go to the mechanical room.
After Shiroya's past self travels to the future, she steps out of the mechanical room. Before {time=21}, {u}I travel to January 5th with the group.{/u}
-Ashiya Tower
After satisfying the final conditions, I finally step out of the labyrinth.

entries.new: 入夜之后

entries.text: I'd been mindlessly staring at the wall in front of me for a few minutes. When that finally registered, I slowly spun around.
entries.new: 我漫无目的地盯着面前的墙壁，已经过了好几分钟。等我终于回过神来，才慢慢转过身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd always thought I'd be quick at adapting to sudden changes, but I'd recently realized how mistaken that was. Still unable to process everything, my brain continually struggled to accept that the previous few days had really happened.
entries.new: 我一向自以为，面对突发变故总能很快适应，最近却发现并非如此。那几天经历的一切，我至今仍难以接受，内心始终无法相信那是真的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I wasn't familiar with the walls around me, but I'd always known of the place. Next to me was Shiroya, less willing to acknowledge her surroundings. Keeping her gaze on the floor, she suddenly spoke for the first time since we'd entered.
entries.new: ……四周的墙壁对我来说很陌生，可这地方我早已听说过。Shiroya就在我身旁，却更不愿去正视周遭。她始终垂眼看着地面，忽然开口——这是进门之后她第一次出声。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I think it'll be time soon.
entries.new: ……我想，时间快到了。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Yeah, probably less than twenty minutes.
entries.new: 嗯，大概不到二十分钟了。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That was all I managed to muster. Even though I was still the same Atsuki as always, it felt like I'd been rewritten into an entirely different entity in only a few days.
entries.new: 我再没能多说什么。我明明还是我自己，却觉得短短几天里，自己已被改写成另一个全然不同的人。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I didn't try to say anything else. During the previous two weeks, I'd grown accustomed to those brief interactions with Shiroya. After I spoke, the lost look in her eyes returned. We had both agreed to go together, but it seemed like neither of us knew what we were doing.
entries.new: 我没有再开口。过去两周，我已经习惯了和Shiroya这样简短地交谈。可我的话一说完，她眼中那份茫然又回来了。我们明明说好要一起来，却似乎谁都不知道自己在做什么。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We awkwardly scanned the vast hall, moving forward tiny steps at a time and awaiting further instructions.
entries.new: 我们尴尬地打量着空旷的大厅，一点一点向前挪，等着下一步指示。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Neither of us had any strength; I'd known Shiroya for more than fifteen years, and not once had she looked so empty. On top of everything else, I hadn't even been able to make her feel any better.
entries.new: 我们俩都没什么力气。我认识Shiroya超过十五年，却从没见过她这样空落落的。更糟的是，我甚至没法让她好受一些。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Despite that, at almost {time=9}, we were inside Ashiya Tower.
entries.new: 尽管如此，将近{time=9}时，我们已经站在芦屋塔里了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The biggest building in Yushibana—the town where we'd always lived. It was situated on the outskirts, and we had never entered it before.
entries.new: 那是丰花最大的建筑——我们一直生活的小镇。它坐落在郊外，我们却从未进去过。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: From the outside, the tower's contrast with its surroundings was immense. Beyond all the similar-looking houses, its size made it visible anywhere in the town. It was that contrast which had caused it to be called a "tower", but it was only as big as an urban building. The structure itself was more or less a cube, essentially as wide as it was tall, but it seemed towering to people who had spent their whole lives in a rural area.
entries.new: 从外观上看，这座塔与周遭环境形成了巨大的反差。越过那些外观雷同的房屋，它的体量使镇上任何地方都能望见它。也正因为这种反差，它才被人称作“塔”，可实际上，它不过是一栋城市建筑的大小。它的结构大致是个立方体，宽和高几乎一样，但对于一辈子生活在乡下的人来说，已经显得高耸入云。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was a place Shiroya and I had always avoided because of the stigma associated with it. A significant amount of the citizens opposed the tower's existence due to both the group who owned it and its unnatural size.
entries.new: 因为这座塔背负的恶名，Shiroya和我一向避而远之。相当一部分市民反对它的存在：既因为拥有它的那伙人，也因为它那不合常理的体量。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I wasn't very familiar with the topic. Apparently, decades in the past, when the building hadn't been anywhere near as large, it was the original Ashiya family's home. It was known that they were a shady family, but they never suffered any real consequences. At that time, they held a silent power over the town, and over the years, it gradually grew stronger.
entries.new: 我对这些事了解不多。据说几十年前，这栋建筑还远没有现在这么大时，曾是芦屋家族最早的宅邸。众所周知，那是个见不得光的家族，却从未真正承担过什么后果。当时，他们暗中掌控着小镇，年复一年，这股势力渐渐壮大。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: They became the image of Yushibana. Anyone visiting from the outside knew about that family before anything else in the town. Over the years, the old residence transformed into a focal point for business and tourism.
entries.new: 他们成了丰花的门面。外来者最先知道的，总是这个家族，然后才是镇上的其他东西。多年间，那座老宅渐渐变成了商业与观光的中心。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I had never immersed myself in the matter, but that was common information that I couldn't even recall where I'd heard first.
entries.new: 我从未深究过这些，但这些事人尽皆知，我甚至想不起最初是从哪里听来的。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The place was some sort of museum, and behind it extended a mountain range that encircled Yushibana. It was known for housing numerous caves that held valuable gemstones, so enthusiasts tended to visit often. The Ashiya family had taken advantage of it and utilized their building as a gallery for the different gemstones that could be found in the nearby mountains.
entries.new: 这地方算是一座博物馆，背后绵延着环绕丰花的山脉。那片山里有许多出产贵重宝石的洞穴，因此常有爱好者前来。芦屋家族便利用了这一点，把自家建筑改作展厅，陈列附近山中能找到的各种宝石。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And when that happened, the part of the town in favor of the tower increased due to the incoming flow of people who specialized in those gemstones. That was what caused a split in the population; the younger residents generally didn't mind Ashiya, while the older maintained their private discontent.
entries.new: 于是，随着专为这些宝石而来的人流增多，镇上支持这座塔的人也多了起来。市民因此分成了两派：年轻居民大多不排斥芦屋，年长者则把不满藏在心里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: That was why we had never entered it, and on top of our more recent circumstances, I thought Shiroya might've been experiencing a feeling of betrayal simply by being there. While I couldn't say I shared that strong of an emotion toward it, I wasn't very fond of the whole thing either.
entries.new: 正因如此，我们从未踏进过这里。再加上最近发生的事，我想Shiroya光是站在这里，或许就已经有种被背叛的感觉。我虽然不至于像她那么强烈，但对这一切也谈不上喜欢。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...{w}The reason why we were inside wasn't one I could easily put into words.
entries.new: ……{w}至于我们为什么会进来，我很难用言语解释。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: There had been constant publicity about the day's event for two weeks. According to Ashiya, they were going to showcase a major discovery, one found in the very same mountains around the town.
entries.new: 这两周来，关于今天活动的宣传铺天盖地。按芦屋的说法，他们将要展出一项重大发现，而它正是出自环绕小镇的同一片山脉。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But that wasn't something that particularly interested me, and I wasn't sure what to expect. Our motivation for coming to the tower wasn't anything as simple as curiosity.
entries.new: 但那并不是我特别感兴趣的事，我也说不清自己究竟在期待什么。我们来这座塔，动机远没有好奇那么简单。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was December 15th. Outside, the environment was cold and coated in snow, and while the temperature inside was regulated, we'd been outside for so long that we still felt unpleasant.
entries.new: 那天是十二月十五日。外头天寒地冻，遍地积雪。室内虽然控着温，但我们在外面站得太久，身上仍觉得难受。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I glanced at Shiroya, who didn't return my look. Feeling slightly agitated, I turned a little.
entries.new: 我瞥了Shiroya一眼，她没有看我。我心里有些烦躁，稍稍偏开了身。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I could see a line of people who had come thanks to Ashiya's ambitious advertisements. Shiroya and I had been at the front of it for a long time.
entries.new: 我能看见一列人，都是被芦屋大张旗鼓的宣传吸引来的。Shiroya和我已经在队伍最前面站了很久。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Next to us was a man I'd never seen before. He was tall and had dark hair, and like us, he seemed distant from everyone else. I hadn't seen him so much as look at me, so I hadn't paid attention to him.
entries.new: 我们旁边站着一个从未见过的男人。他个子很高，头发深黑，和我们一样，似乎与旁人隔着一层。他连看都没看过我一眼，我也就没去留意他。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We were next to him because we would go see the gemstone in groups of three. Since we'd been the initial three to show up, we formed the first group.
entries.new: 我们和他挨在一起，是因为要三人一组去看宝石。由于我们是最先到的三个人，便自然成了第一组。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The entrance fee had been expensive, but we'd paid it well in advance. From our perspective, it had been worth it.
entries.new: 入场费不便宜，不过我们早就付清了。在我们看来，那笔钱花得值。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We remained by the door that would open at {time=9}, simply waiting for that to happen. At our left was another door that would open at the same time, and according to what we'd been told, both led to the main floor of the tower.{w} On that particular day, not many people seemed to care about that, as everyone who could be seen was in our same line.
entries.new: 我们守在{time=9}会打开的那扇门旁，只等着它开启。左手边还有另一扇同时打开的门；据工作人员说，两扇门都通向塔的主楼层。{w}不过那天，似乎没多少人关心这一点——目之所及的人，全都在我们这条队伍里。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: For a moment, I wondered what the big deal was. Yushibana wasn't a large town, so the amount of people waiting behind us was fairly impressive. All that for a gemstone didn't seem quite right to me.
entries.new: 有一瞬间，我纳闷这有什么值得大动干戈的。丰花并不是大城镇，可排在后面的人数却相当可观。为了一块宝石闹出这么大的阵仗，我总觉得有些不对劲。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But perhaps it made sense, given that it was Ashiya's event. They cared about appearances, as anyone could attest. They had their hands in all types of business, but the most important one was looking good.
entries.new: 但或许也说得通，毕竟这是芦屋办的活动。谁都知道，他们最看重门面。他们涉足各种生意，而最重要的一门，就是让自己显得光鲜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Apart from the line, the only other people in the lobby were guards talking with a policeman, a woman behind the reception desk checking everyone's tickets, and a janitor who had been scrubbing the same part of the floor for a while.
entries.new: 除了排队的人，大厅里只剩下几名和警察交谈的保安、前台后检查众人门票的女人，以及一个在同一块地板上擦了半天的清洁工。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It was all unsettling and alien. The event itself was an abstract thing to me, and my view on the people who ran it was far from positive. All I could do was look at things and wait for it all to start.
entries.new: 这一切都令人不安，又透着陌生。活动本身对我来说很抽象，而我对操办它的人也没什么好印象。我能做的，只是看着四周，等一切开始。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We'd been asked to leave our phones outside for the duration of our stay, as nothing of the sort was permitted in the building. That meant that I had no way of looking at the time; there weren't any clocks on the walls.
entries.new: 他们要求我们在停留期间把手机留在外面，因为楼内不允许携带这类物品。也就是说，我没办法看时间；墙上也没有任何钟表。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Adding the fact that the person I was with was clearly uncomfortable and trying to hide it, the long wait had been much more tedious than I'd hoped.
entries.new: 再加上身边那个人明显不自在，却还努力掩饰，这场漫长的等待比我预想的还要难熬。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I continued looking at her, not knowing how to deal with the situation better. Finally, after minutes of looking down, she suddenly lifted her head as if she'd just remembered that she was in a public environment.
entries.new: 我继续看着她，却不知道还能怎样处理眼前的局面。终于，在低头了几分钟之后，她忽然抬起头，仿佛这才想起自己正身处公共场合。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Following behind, she looked at me and seemed to try to smile.
entries.new: 她跟在我身后，看向我，似乎想挤出一个笑容。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But it was barely visible before vanishing again.
entries.new: 可那笑意还没成形，便又消失了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...I kept falling back into negative thoughts. No matter how I tried, I couldn't help that.
entries.new: ……我又止不住地往坏处想。无论怎么努力，都控制不了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I needed to be stronger and help lift Shiroya out of the pit she was in, but that was tricky, seeing as I first had to get out of the same one.
entries.new: 我得坚强起来，把Shiroya从她陷落的深渊里拉出来；可难就难在，我自己也先得从同一处深渊中爬出去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: So I just struggled against my feelings, wishing all the while that I could go back to how things had been before.
entries.new: 所以我只能和自己的情绪较劲，一边盼着一切能回到从前。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Minutes later, a well-dressed man who'd been standing near the entrance told us that if we weren't waiting for the event, we could go through the left door.
entries.new: 几分钟后，一个衣着考究、原本站在入口附近的男人告诉我们，如果不是在等活动开始，可以从左边的门进去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shortly after, a tall, blonde woman wearing a suit entered through the one on the right.
entries.new: 没多久，一个身材高挑、金发、穿着西装的女子从右边的门走了进来。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I'd seen her in a coat earlier, before she'd disappeared through one of the doors. She looked over everyone present and began to explain what the procedure would be.
entries.new: 早些时候，我见过她穿着大衣，后来她便进了其中一扇门。此刻她环视在场众人，开始说明流程。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sorry for the wait, everyone. We'll now begin the group entrances.{w} My name is Naomi. I'll be chaperoning today's guided visit.
entries.new: 各位，久等了。现在开始分组入场。{w}我叫Naomi，今天的参观由我陪同。
entries.speaker: sa

entries.text: As you likely already know, groups of three will move forward in turns. Each viewing is estimated to take approximately fifteen minutes.{w} Once inside, I will personally explain what we have prepared, and I will also be available to answer questions within the specified time.
entries.new: 各位想必已经知道，三人一组依次入场。每组参观预计约十五分钟。{w}进去之后，我会亲自说明我们准备的展出内容，也会在规定时间内回答大家的问题。
entries.speaker: sa

entries.text: Naomi's explanation was directed at everyone present, but it was hard to believe anyone farther back could've heard her. She continued in a monotone voice.
entries.new: Naomi是对着在场所有人说明的，但很难相信排在后面的人能听见。她继续用单调的语气说着。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Keep in mind that phones and video cameras are strictly prohibited. I ask for all of you to please be patient and await your turn.
entries.new: 请注意，手机和摄像机一律禁止携带。也请大家耐心等候，按顺序入场。
entries.speaker: sa

entries.text: When her scripted message was over, she relaxed her posture and directed her look at us.
entries.new: 当她说完这段照本宣科的话后，放松了姿态，把目光转向我们。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You three are the first group, correct?
entries.new: 你们三位是第一组，对吗？
entries.speaker: sa

entries.text: Seconds later, nobody had answered. The two people at my sides had barely paid attention to her, so I spoke before she would have to ask again.
entries.new: 过了几秒，没有人回答。我身边的两个人几乎没在听她说话，于是我趁她再问之前开了口。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Yes.
entries.new: 是的。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...All right, then. Please follow me to the event room to be the first to see the Sekimeiya.
entries.new: ……好的，那么请跟我到活动室，你们将是第一批看到 Sekimeiya 的人。
entries.speaker: sa

entries.text: I'd heard that word many times recently. As soon as she said it, she turned around and walked through the same door she'd entered from.
entries.new: 这个词我最近已经听过很多次了。她话音刚落，就转身走进了自己来时的那扇门。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I looked to my right to check on Shiroya. Her demeanor hadn't changed, but she was aware of the situation.
entries.new: 我看了看右边的 Shiroya。她的神情没有变化，但已经跟上了状况。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: By the time I turned back, the man on my left had nearly reached the door. It seemed he was taking the initiative despite his unenthused appearance.
entries.new: 等我回过头，左边的男人已经快走到门边了。虽然他看起来兴致缺缺，却意外地主动。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Rather, it was probably better to think of myself as lagging behind than him being proactive. I followed, motioning to Shiroya as I did. She approached me, still wearing her heavy-looking coat.
entries.new: 或者说，与其说他积极，不如说是我落后了。我一边跟上去，一边向 Shiroya 招手。她朝我走来，身上还穿着那件看起来厚重的外套。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We found ourselves in a long hallway. We could see many doors lining each wall, some opened and connected by a decorative handrail. However, there were no traces of Naomi or the man.
entries.new: 我们来到一条长长的走廊里。两侧的墙上有许多门，其中几扇开着，旁边连着装饰性的扶手。然而，Naomi 和那个男人已经不见踪影。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The floor seemed pointlessly wide. Up to the end of the hall, I could see a number of security cameras hanging from the ceiling. As we started walking, unclear about where to go, I found it appropriate to try talking with Shiroya again.
entries.new: 地面宽得有些浪费。一直到走廊尽头，我都能看到天花板上挂着好几台监控摄像头。我们不知道该往哪走，只能先迈开步子，我觉得差不多该再和 Shiroya 说说话了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Are you feeling better?
entries.new: 你感觉好点了吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Oh... Yeah, I'm fine. Don't worry about it.
entries.new: 哦……嗯，我没事。别担心。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: ...She continued walking, assuming that was the end of our exchange.
entries.new: ……她继续往前走，似乎觉得我们的话说到这里就结束了。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tried to press it a bit further.
entries.new: 我试着再追问一下。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Do you regret coming?
entries.new: ……你后悔来了吗？
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...No, of course not.{w} I'm seriously glad we're here. I mean it.
entries.new: ……不，当然没有。{w} 我们能来这里，我真的很开心。我是认真的。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: I know how you feel, okay? It's... the same for me. It doesn't help a lot to say it, but I don't want to see you sad.
entries.new: 我懂你的感受，真的。我也……一样。虽然这么说没什么用，但我不想看到你难过。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm here because I want to be, Atsuki. I'm okay. This is where I need to be right now. Sorry, I must look terrible.
entries.new: 我是自己想来的，Atsuki。我没事。现在我就该待在这里。抱歉，我的样子一定很难看。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: She wasn't being very convincing.
entries.new: 她这些话实在没什么说服力。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...You know this isn't something you need to apologize for. Nothing about this is your fault.
entries.new: ……你知道这不是你需要道歉的事。这一切都不是你的错。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm... not so sure. I wish I didn't have to be a drag for you now.
entries.new: 我……不太确定。真希望我现在没有拖累你。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: H-Hey, come on. If you want to leave, we still can. Don't feel like you have to push yourself for my sake.
entries.new: 喂、喂，别这样。如果你想回去，我们现在还能走。不用为了我勉强自己。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: It's all right. Thank you.{w} Let's continue, though. I was the one who wanted to do this.
entries.new: 没关系，谢谢你。{w} 不过，我们继续吧。想来这里的是我。
entries.speaker: s

entries.text: Okay.
entries.new: 好。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: We'd hoped coming to the exhibition would be for the better. Once it was settled that we wouldn't back out, I looked around hesitantly until a voice calling for us came from the middle of the hallway, through an open door.
entries.new: 我们本来希望来展览会能让情况好转。确定不会半途而废后，我犹豫地环顾四周，直到走廊中间一扇敞开的门里传来叫我们的声音。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You two, hurry up! The clock is ticking.
entries.new: 你们两个，快点！时间有限。
entries.speaker: sa

entries.text: Her unprofessional shout broke the silence and drew us forward.
entries.new: 她这声不太专业的喊话打破了寂静，把我们引了过去。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I saw her figure in a seemingly empty room. Through the other doors, there were cabinets covered by red cloths.
entries.new: 我看到她站在一个看似空荡荡的房间里。透过其他门，可以看到一些盖着红布的展示柜。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Good, we're all finally here. Now we can start.
entries.new: 好，我们总算到齐了。现在可以开始了。
entries.speaker: sa

entries.text: Once I went inside, I realized my initial impression had been wrong. The room would've been barren if it weren't for a single cabinet covered by a velvet curtain.
entries.new: 走进去后，我才发现自己刚才的印象有误。这个房间若非有一个盖着天鹅绒幕布的展示柜，会显得空无一物。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The black-haired man was there, yet again looking entirely aloof and fixing his eyes on the plain opposite wall.
entries.new: 那个黑发男人也在，依旧一副完全漠不关心的样子，眼睛盯着对面素净的墙壁。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: All right. It would be helpful if you could tell me your names since you know mine.
entries.new: 那么，既然你们已经知道我的名字，方便的话也请告诉我你们的名字。
entries.speaker: sa

entries.text: While she said that, she closed the door we'd come through, and I took notice of the security camera in one of the corners, which was fitting for the place we were in. There was another closed door on the opposite wall, so we had fifteen minutes ahead of us where we would be shut inside.
entries.new: 她一边说，一边关上了我们进来的门。我注意到角落里有台监控摄像头，放在这种地方倒也合适。对面墙上还有另一扇关着的门，看来接下来的十五分钟我们会被关在这里面。
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Naomi looked at me expectantly, probably because I'd been the one to speak earlier.

entries.text: Atsuki Hakutoki.
entries.new: Atsuki Hakutoki。
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Shiroya Mirana.
entries.new: Shiroya Mirana。

entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The black-haired man didn't respond immediately when we eyed him.
