entries.text: Wait a second... Wh-Why do I have to do this? Shouldn't Ido be the one? This could go horribly wrong!
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: No. At the time of the event, Ido has no reason to be in the event room. Furthermore, it's likely the people present will be investigated, which could lead Ashiya to find the real Sekimeiya in the cart before we can obtain it.{w} This could go wrong, sure, but it can work. However, see it as a chance I'm giving you.{w} You screwed up badly. Not only should you redeem yourself to us, but to yourself. If you're found, you will be seen as a killer. Make sure this plan works before you think of asking for our help again.
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: W-Will you offer help if this goes well?
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: That's something you will have to ask again after the 15th. Until then, you're still nothing but trouble for us—disposing of you is what we should do. ...Do you understand why it is essential that this is not a failure?
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...{w}I don't even get what you said, though. I'll still be recorded if I do this.
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: No. The smokescreen will cover you. We'll make sure it works as a barrier for the camera.
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: But what about the hallway!? I'll be seen going to the cleaning room!
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: That is one reason why smoke should also be released there.{w} Like in every guided visit, everyone else will be in the lobby. If smoke appears in both hallways, everyone will quickly evacuate, as they'll be worried about it being poisonous or there being a fire. Then, the exit will be guarded to make sure nobody runs out with stolen gems.{w} Katei Kuiji will be in the security room, so due to the smoke, he won't be able to leave it without falling unconscious, and he won't see what's happening in the building.{w} When everyone is knocked out, you will go to the cleaning room and obtain our fake. It is essential that you do this first to make sure no one sees you. You will leave your smoke grenade in the cart and subsequently go back to swap the gemstones.
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...Who will set off the smoke outside the event room, though?
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Nobody will. Setting up a timer is the easiest thing in the world. We know when they have to go off: at {time=9:04.}
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: No, we don't...! The event will begin at {time=9}, but we don't know when the cabinet will be unlocked!
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: That doesn't matter. Ido has seen the key and how to use it. If the smoke goes off before the cabinet is unlocked, the guide will be knocked out, and they will have the key on their person.
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: And where exactly will the smoke bombs be in the hallways?
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Don't you remember? We can use the handrails.{w} Behind them, the small grenades will be hidden, and it works perfectly for us. The cameras in the hallways are placed to focus on the doors, so there are parts of the handrails that aren't visible.{w} When Ido is cleaning, he can secretly place a grenade and slide it toward a point of the handrail that's being recorded. We will need two per hallway, and it'll seem like anyone could've placed them the previous day.
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Finally, both subordinates understood how serious their boss was and broke into a sweat. As they took off and draped their heavy attire on the back of their chairs, they began to process each step of what they would be performing.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...And that's not all. There's something else we'll do that will divert suspicion from Ido.{w} After all, if this works, we still wouldn't be in the clear. After suffering such a major attack, will Ashiya really believe nothing was stolen? If they're careful, they might not believe it and end up finding the real Sekimeiya.{w} So, we will give them a reason to believe it.{w} Their focus will be on the Sekimeiya; that's what they expect to be targeted, and the measures they're taking clearly involve it, as proven by the new cabinet and it only having one key. Targeting a different room will be much less problematic.{w} In the morning, before the event, the cameras will be monitored. However, there are more cameras than monitors, and only the hallways and a few crystal rooms are displayed at once, correct, Ido?
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...Yes. I've never seen the smaller one in hallway A being displayed. It's normally just the hallway.
entries.speaker: ido

entries.text: Exactly. This means that if you put all the gems there into a case, you won't be seen. We would usually never do this, as it makes you the only suspect, but this isn't an issue this time.{w} The curtains aren't raised until {time=9:10}, so you'll leave all of them down. You'll also leave the case in the room, in the corner beneath the camera, so that we can have a visitor be there when the smoke is released, crouching right as it happens. If they keep their head near the floor as they exit the tower with the case, they won't fall unconscious.{w} Two minutes after the smoke has been released, he will attempt to flee. This will make Ashiya think their expectations were subverted and that the failed attack had that room as its final target.{w} ...I doubt Faiten will be willing to take this job under any circumstances, but I'll find the right person without telling them the full extent of the plan.
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Since the reason behind doing this is passing off that room as the target, the smoke will need to be released there as well, so that's where Ido will leave the last grenade.
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: ...But, what...? I'm very confused. All of this will be recorded.
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Yes.{w} Before, I said that infecting the computer again could be risky. While that is true, it won't be an issue if we take the proper measures.{w} When the smoke is released, I will infect the computer remotely. While Katei is overwhelmed by the attack, it'll take me a few seconds to erase the saved footage of the previous 24 hours. Then, I will immediately disconnect our access so that we can't be tracked.{w} This will work in four different ways.{w} It will remove the footage that incriminates Ido.{w} It will remove the footage showing the source of the smoke in the event room.{w} It will make them think we had to remove the hallways' footage to hide who placed the grenades there, when that's not actually needed.{w} And lastly, it will hide that we can access the computer at any time, because they might think we were able to erase the footage thanks to the commotion of the attack.{w} ...This is it. This is what we'll do, and how we'll nab the Sekimeiya.
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: Once the plan is a success, we'll get it out of the building with the cart. However, how do we let Ashiya know their Sekimeiya is fake? Whatever the best answer is, it relies on the crafting process.{w} You said the Sekimeiya's kept pretty cold. There aren't many chemical reactions that occur at low temperatures, but perhaps we could make use of one to damage the Sekimeiya after a couple of days of exposure.{w} If not, then a mere timed reaction would suffice, one that would break our Sekimeiya and leave behind a card with our name.
entries.speaker: kr

entries.text: When Katei saw the busy waveform, he knew his bait had been effective.{w} Since Xyn had attacked the gem shop, Ido hadn't spoken to his boss. Katei had wanted to know Xyn's position after their failure, so he had given Ido information about the Sekimeiya to report to his group.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At a low volume, he listened to the audio in his dim office. The second time, the conversation was a lot more substantial.{w} Katei thrilled internally; an overwhelming amount of details were being revealed to him. He finally knew many of Xyn's secrets that had tormented him for so long.{w} He heard Xyn design their plan, even though the end sounded muffled. Ashiya's lure wouldn't work; there would be no attack before the 15th, and most importantly, Katei could no longer follow through with his scheme.{w} Xyn would attack during the daytime. The alarm wouldn't be activated, and Katei's voice could be heard by other people. In addition, even if the alarm was activated, Katei wouldn't be able to offer a Xyn member a quick escape, as the outside of the building wouldn't be deserted.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, there was something else Katei realized: Xyn were right. The Sekimeiya's value was already much higher than what Ashiya had expected.{w} To incentivize Xyn's attack, Ashiya had been building an air of mystery around the gemstone, which had rapidly expanded. Until the 15th, the Sekimeiya's worth would be far higher than everything else Ashiya had ever possessed.{w} Katei didn't feel pressured. He had very valuable information, and he had learned that the concept of his plan could still be executed, albeit differently. He could anonymously threaten Ido with the audio, but that would give away Katei's source of information, and unlike after his previous plan, Xyn wouldn't be indebted to him. As such, he decided to change his way of thinking for the time being.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The Sekimeiya... he could obtain it himself and postpone the idea of blackmailing Xyn. He had the key to the cabinet and a trump card he'd saved for years—the storeroom's secret.{w} Before Katei's parents had died, the building had undergone severe expansions. The secret corridor had always remained a hidden part of the lowest floor, but nobody who knew about it remained.{w} Naturally, Katei had tested it already to deduce whether Xyn were aware of its existence. He had easily been able to confirm it had never opened during their attacks.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: How could Katei take the Sekimeiya out of the tower? Despite all he knew, it wasn't a simple task.{w} He couldn't act out a fake Xyn attack when he didn't have the night shift: if he entered through the storeroom, he would be seen from the security room.{w} He could take action when he had the night shift. He could bring the Sekimeiya to the storeroom and claim Xyn had erased the security footage. But would such a thing be believable?{w} He wasn't worried that Xyn could threaten him anymore—he had the upper hand in that battle, as he could expose a good deal about them. Yet, Katei's story would be too convenient. His alarm would have to be somehow bypassed, and Katei would have to let them escape.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What if he activated the alarm by forcing open the cabinet? Then, when the exit unlocked, no Xyn member would be found in the building, and the Sekimeiya would've magically disappeared.{w} There was only one way Katei could make that work: by saying he had seen someone escaping toward the storeroom. However, he didn't want to reveal the existence of the hidden door yet.{w} There was no smooth story that let Katei weasel out. He didn't want to be investigated by Ashiya or Xyn, but every scenario sounded iffy and had him as an easy suspect.{w} That was until he realized that the perfect moment existed.{w} A moment where he wouldn't be the only suspect, and where his story would be believed without doubt: the day of the event.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The day when Xyn would be in the tower, and when Katei would be in the security room. He could use their own attack against them to obfuscate his involvement.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He knew what would happen and what Xyn's actions would be. He immediately thought of a way to take advantage of them.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The Sekimeiya cabinet had been designed to trigger the alarm upon being minimally damaged. At {time=9:04}, a vast cloud of smoke was going to be released in the event room. Even though the cabinet could be unlocked, the mere damage of the smoke could set off the alarm.{w} In any case, if the alarm went off at that time, it wouldn't be questioned: a real attack would've triggered it, so it would've served its function.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei had designed the system, and he knew Xyn didn't have access to the tower's computer. If he altered the system to automatically activate the alarm at that time, no one would know.{w} He could trap Xyn in the tower and commandeer the rest of their plan himself. In addition, Katei had another reason to trigger the alarm: to aid Xyn before his intervention. The only way their plan could fail was if people from the outside quickly raided the building despite the smoke. That was something the alarm could prevent.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei's initial idea was promising, and he could develop it further.{w} Xyn would disable the hallway A cameras, where the security room and the storeroom were. That meant that before the attack, Katei could quickly go to the lobby to discuss what to do during the event with the police. That would be the last recording of hallway A.{w} Upon seeing the smoke, everyone would rapidly evacuate, unaware that the alarm was soon to be activated. Then, during the chaos, Katei would reenter the hallway.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That would no longer be caught by the cameras. As he'd heard Xyn's discussion, he knew that by crawling, he would avoid falling unconscious.{w} He knew what Atase's movements would be—the alarm wouldn't influence them. He would go to the cleaning room, so Katei had the opportunity to take the Sekimeiya out of the cabinet if it was unlocked. If it wasn't, he'd go take it from the cleaning cart after Atase finished his job.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, he could rapidly go to the storeroom and leave the Sekimeiya behind the movable wall. Lei had told him it couldn't be kept at a warm temperature, but the storeroom's corridor was colder than the rest of the tower due to its lack of insulation and air conditioning.{w} Lastly, he would leave using his unique key. Everyone would be in front of the entrance, so he wouldn't be seen stepping out of the building. Then, he would appear from behind them, as if he had evacuated, which hallway A's camera would corroborate.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Nobody would be in the security room, so after twelve hours, the shutter would open. Then, someone inside the building would be guaranteed to be a member of Xyn and responsible for triggering the alarm.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, nobody would know the Sekimeiya had been stolen because Xyn's fake would remain inside, and nobody would suspect Katei of having any involvement, as he couldn't have. Not even Xyn would suspect him.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And in the future, he could retrieve the real Sekimeiya from the storeroom without an issue.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Everything was finally in motion, and the long wait for the day of the event began.{w} Ashiya, Xyn, and Katei. Each of those three parties had their own unique agenda.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Every night, Ashiya expected Xyn's attack. However, Katei knew it wouldn't happen yet and kept mentally rehearsing his plan.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Meanwhile, Xyn received their replica of the Sekimeiya.{w} Ido, who had seen, touched, and measured the original, confirmed there was no glaring difference between the two, and that unless Ashiya had foreseen a replica being created, it would work.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As the days approached, Ashiya realized Xyn were likely to not fall for their trap, and as Xyn had predicted, the Sekimeiya continued to grow more valuable in the eyes of the world.{w} Ashiya hadn't fully prepared the event yet, so a trusted employee of theirs was chosen to plan out the guided visits.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase was under a lot of pressure. He had to make sure the plan was a success, and if he executed what had been laid out perfectly, the odds would be in his favor.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All the preparations had been made. Slowly, the days of December ticked up to the 15th.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, nobody expected what would happen on that day.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Eight people were trapped in Ashiya Tower, but they weren't alone. That was the catalyst of the construction of a mountainous maze.{w} Who reached its peak? It wasn't everyone who began the climb.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You are lucky enough to have access to all its sides, but what about the peak?{w} Three parties formed the mountain's base, unaware of how high it would go.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Xyn
Katei
Ashiya
Continue
Contrition
When the tower opened, Atase was the only person waiting outside. He wore light attire despite the cold.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He bowed at the receptionist and stepped in slowly. A man walked up to him, asking for his ticket. After showing it and confirming that he didn't have a phone, he stepped to the hallway B door.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was very early in the morning. For a while, all he heard was the receptionist shuffling a bunch of papers behind the desk.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The next person he saw was Ido. Without looking over, he casually made his way to the hallway.{w} It took him a while to come back. When he did, his clothes were different, and he was carrying a cleaning bucket.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase was relieved. Nothing had happened, so Ido's part of the plan had gone well. He didn't have the cleaning cart, as it was waiting for Atase with the fake Sekimeiya.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Idly mopping the floor, Ido got close to Atase. That was when he dropped a tiny grenade in his pocket. At that point, everything was ready—the action was poised to begin.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase turned around when he heard something at his back. Two more people were by the entrance: a boy and a girl.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Out of nowhere, Atase felt a sudden wave of heat. ...He had seen the boy before.{w} In Musashi Gemstones, he had been the first to be hit by the smoke. Atsuki Hakutoki was his name, and he'd been safely discharged from the hospital.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase swiftly looked away. On that day, his face had been disguised, but what if he was recognized? He stared at the floor as they walked closer to him, clenching his fists tightly.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...{w}He had to avoid eye contact; the boy next to him had lost someone, and it had been his fault.{w} He had taken a glance at the girl as well. Although he hadn't seen her before, the eyes below her red hair looked identical to the boy's.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: {time=9:00} was distant. Long before it, police officers arrived outside the tower.{w} Atase's rough facial description must've been known. He didn't think he'd be recognized, but he couldn't bring himself to look back.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All at once, a wave of people flooded in. Faint chatter took over the silence, but none of it reached Atase. He had to look calm and know exactly what to do.{w} He saw someone he knew outside the lobby. However, that person didn't know who Atase was. His job was to take out a suitcase at {time=9:06.}
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Ido had left through the opposite hallway a while ago. When he came back, he started to mop the floor a second time.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Slowly, the time kept passing.{w} After Ido was done with the little plaza, he entered again, mopping the new snowy footprints and the already shining floor.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: For a while, he kept doing that. He had to stay there, as he knew what was soon to happen in the hallways.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Shiroya...?
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Atase's heart skipped a beat. Behind him, he'd heard the voice of Katei Kuiji. However, that name...
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Is this yours? I think you dropped it.
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: ...Thank you.
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Atase's head slowly turned to the girl.{w} She wasn't Shiroya. That was the name of the girl whose memory pressed down on his shoulders.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Who was that, then?{w} Atase would soon learn.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At {time=9}, the door to hallway B opened. Through it came Naomi Cabca, who gave a brief explanation of the event.{w} It was time. Only four minutes were left.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Are you three the first group?
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Yeah, we've been here for a while.
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: Perfect. Please follow me to the event room to be the first to see the Sekimeiya.
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Quietly, the three people at the front of the line stepped into the hallway and were drawn to the room in the middle.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A single cabinet was there, covered by a velvet curtain. It was a sight Atase had seen before through a picture.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All right. It would be helpful if you could tell me your names so that I know how to address you.
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: I'm Miiya Moiromo.
entries.speaker: mnn

entries.text: That was her name. It was one Atase remembered. Miiya Moiromo had been in the shop as well, but she hadn't been hit by the impact of the explosion.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: "Akaro Esata". For the first time in hours, Atase opened his mouth, voicing the name that had been on his ticket.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...Atsuki Hakutoki.
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: Naomi began to explain the story behind the Sekimeiya. As she did, Atase wondered if any bit of truth was coming out of her mouth.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Part of the experience is the touch, so I will open the glass and let you experience it yourselves. However, I must insist that you be gentle and keep your hands inside the cabinet at all times.
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: She took out a keyring. After inserting a small one into the cabinet, she unlocked it.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: I have a question.
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Hm? What is it?
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Atase suppressed his nervousness as best he could. The cabinet had been unlocked, so the plan was very close to succeeding. However, a few seconds still remained until {time=9:04.}
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He attempted to slow Naomi down. She had been about to raise the curtain and let them touch the gemstone. If that happened before the smoke was released, the Sekimeiya could be hit by it, which could later reveal that the clean one was Xyn's fake.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: You keep mentioning how valuable the Sekimeiya is, but is there proof of that? The way you're explaining it, you don't even say what kind of gem it is, only that it's "rare".
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: But the value could've been arbitrarily created by Ashiya, as it's not being officially recognized as anything more than an unusual discovery.
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Well, I will let you decide that for yourself. As you said, it's not categorized because nobody was able to properly appraise it. That's all you need to be assured of its value.
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: I apologize for being skeptical, but you must be aware that Ashiya aren't exactly recognized for their fairness.
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Do you have a reason to say that?
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Yes, that everyone in the lobby sounded as skeptical as I am.
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: Maybe seeing it for yourself will convince you.
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: That's what I'm hoping.
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: After a pause, Naomi shook her head and crouched beside the cabinet. When she raised the curtain, a huge cloud of smoke rose with it, coming from the grenade Atase had taken out of his pocket.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before anyone could resist, Atase had already fallen to the floor. Looking down and covering his nose, he avoided having his consciousness fade.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Once everyone plummeted down, a sudden, unsettling silence consumed the room.{w} What was happening outside? Had everyone evacuated? Had the gems been brought out in the suitcase? For a few seconds, Atase had to wait to make sure nobody remained conscious.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He heard someone running through hallway A. It must have been the man with the gemstones, but why? Two minutes hadn't passed yet.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase's eyes widened. What the hell was that sound?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He waited, wondering what was happening. ...Had the plan been a failure?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: After a few seconds, the loud noise faded. However, Atase could not hear anything else outside the room.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When he looked up, he couldn't believe he was in the same place. Very little light was being cast from the ceiling, and the walls had become dark.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The three people who'd been with him were lying on the floor. Once he knew he could move, he silently stepped to hallway B.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Again, it was hard to believe it was the same place as before. However, nobody was there.{w} Covering his face, Atase dashed to the cleaning room.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There was light; almost no smoke had gone through the door.{w} Occupying most of the space, the cart sat in the room. Without hesitating, he dropped the smoke grenade inside it.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The fake Sekimeiya was there. However, Atase couldn't touch it with his bare hands, or he would leave smoky fingerprints on it. He took it with the clean sleeves of his shirt and brought it to the hallway, crouching so that the remaining smoke wouldn't make contact with it.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Back in the event room, he walked to the cabinet. Like Naomi had been about to do, he raised the curtain.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...{w}H-Huh?
entries.speaker: ta

entries.text: He stopped cold, suddenly bewildered. Two glowing stones were in front of him.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Why? He couldn't comprehend what he was seeing.{w} Had there been two Sekimeiya?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase had to rush, but he didn't know what to do. If he took both gemstones, Xyn's plan would never work.{w} Dumbfounded, he reached for one of the two; he could only replace a single one.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He felt a screen of glass that he was able to slide open. Then, without placing his fingers on it, he took a gemstone out, swapping it with his.{w} Still in awe, he closed the glass and dropped the curtain down.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He ran back with the gem in his hands. After locating the door, he moved into hallway B and silently went to the cleaning room.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He dropped the Sekimeiya next to the grenade, and once he was done, Atase rushed back to the event room.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He made sure to close the door and stepped to the spot where he'd fallen down.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, the darkness prevented him from noticing something.{w} Naomi was no longer there.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: While Atase lay down, he heard sounds around him: the floor wasn't empty.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Just what was happening? Everything started to become stranger when nobody entered where he was.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His job was to stay there, and that was what he did.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...{w}But he couldn't make sense of it. Why weren't they being rescued?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wh—{w=0.4} *cough*
entries.speaker: ann

entries.text: The boy woke up.{w} That was the start of a very long day.{w} During the previous weeks, Atase had come up with countless outcomes. However, the real one was far from any he'd devised.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They were trapped. The alarm he'd heard had removed all methods of escape.{w} When he learned Naomi had left the event room before his return, he had to hide his fear. ...Could she have noticed Atase's absence upon awakening?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was one of his initial questions, but they didn't stop piling up. Atase would have to spend twelve hours in that building until he could leave.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He didn't know how worried he had to be or what had triggered the alarm. Even though the building was full of cameras, he knew not to be afraid of them.{w} He was told the internet connection had been cut by the alarm. In the meantime, Xyn couldn't remotely access the computer. However, he knew his group well. According to Katei, at {time=21}, the connection would come back, and Xyn would immediately erase all the recorded footage.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He recalled the conversation he'd had with his boss word by word; he knew how important it was for him not to fail.{w} Therefore, despite the unforeseen alarm, Atase had only one priority: to make the plan a success.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Inside Out
It was almost time.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Upon arriving at the tower, Katei had listened to the latest recording. As he'd hoped, Ido and his boss had talked one last time and gone over their movements.{w} Katei took out the SD card—he couldn't allow that audio to be heard by anyone else. As he didn't want the card on his person either, he hid it in the security room.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The time was rapidly approaching, and he didn't have the opportunity to go back to the staff room. While he tried to remain calm, he hid the voice recorder as well. Although the large device could've been found if Ashiya searched, he knew the SD card wouldn't be, which was all that mattered.{w} Through the monitors, Katei saw the first group approaching the event room. He had to act.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Even though nobody was seeing him, he approached the hallway nonchalantly. During the previous days, he'd kept coming up with good excuses to get out of the security room at that time.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hallway A was empty, but as soon as Katei entered it, so did someone else. From the lobby came a man with long hair who he'd never seen before.{w} Paying no attention to Katei, he walked forward.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Behind the handrails, Katei knew the grenades were concealed. However, he couldn't look at them because that footage was going to be reviewed.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei couldn't get distracted. Keeping his expression natural, he stepped into the lobby.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The room was full of people. All the visitors formed a line behind hallway B, while police officers conversed with Ashiya's guard.{w} Dote and Asfu, Katei's co-workers, greeted him with a smile. Their job was to uncover the cabinets in most of the crystal rooms, but they knew very few people there that day wanted to see those.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: One more person reacted to Katei's arrival: the janitor. However, only Katei noticed it, as Ido looked away immediately.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...{w}Nobody was looking at him, and he didn't want to walk away from the door. As if waiting for the conversation to end, he stared at the police as they talked.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei's plan wasn't guaranteed to work, but he wasn't at risk. Once the smoke was released, the chance to step back into the hallway might not have existed. If someone gestured at Katei to evacuate, he couldn't turn around.{w} However, it didn't matter; he wouldn't be blamed for the attack, and Xyn's plan would still fail. Furthermore, he could attempt to sneak away outside and then reenter the building through the storeroom anyway.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The time passed faster than Katei had imagined. All of a sudden, he noticed the light in hallway A disappear.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wh-What's this!?
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Smoke! Something happened in the hallway!
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Someone opened the door in front of the crowd. In an instant, a plume of smoke invaded the lobby, and the door was forcibly shut again.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It's in both hallways!
entries.speaker: nn

entries.text: Katei felt a shock going through his body: that was the moment. In the blink of an eye, everyone had turned around toward the exit, while both police officers were alerting their superiors.{w} As quickly as he could, Katei dashed into the hallway and dropped to his hands and knees.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: On the floor, someone almost crashed onto him. A person he couldn't distinguish through the veil of smoke rapidly crawled to the lobby, slamming the door shut behind them.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Suddenly, Katei could only hear his heartbeat. That person was undoubtedly the man he'd seen entering the hallway, but he couldn't be heard anymore. Only faint yells could.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was until a loud alarm rang through the building. Immediately afterward, a rough sound came from the lobby, along with stronger yells. The shutter was closing.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And just like that, Katei's plan was set in motion. He had trapped himself, but nobody had realized it.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He'd seen the floor through the cameras: it was very likely only him and Atase were conscious. With utmost care, he slowly crawled toward the event room.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: From outside, he heard a sound: Atase was standing up. Amidst the pure silence, Katei heard him going to the cleaning room.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was Katei's chance to open the door slightly. When he did, he saw the floor of the event room, but all the bodies were too far away to be distinguished.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Through the gap, he stared. He knew the darkness would prevent Atase from noticing him, and there was something he had to see.{w} Days earlier, he had uncovered the cabinet's curtain. ...He had seen two identical Sekimeiya lying atop the cushion.{w} Although he'd gotten scared at first, Xyn hadn't planted a fake yet—he knew Ashiya had two identical gemstones.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Xyn would only be able to replace one, but Katei had the chance to obtain both. He merely had to observe from the hallway to learn which one got replaced.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It only took Atase a few seconds to come back. When he did, he approached the cabinet while holding a glowing stone.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Despite the darkness, once he uncovered the curtain, Katei was able to perceive Atase's shock. Two gemstones were contained in the cabinet.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He was completely still until he reached for one of them. After taking out the rightmost one, Atase placed his own inside.{w} He ran back without wasting even a second.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was Katei's moment. Overwhelmed by his unrelenting heartbeat, he rushed to the cabinet, covering his nose as he looked down.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Admittedly, there was a small difference between them, but he knew the gem on the left was the valuable one. After taking it out, he hurriedly dropped the curtain as if nothing had happened.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He reentered the hallway. Everything was going as planned, but his frantic breaths refused to steady.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The other Sekimeiya would be in the cleaning cart. Katei only had to be in the tower for a few more seconds.{w} Hallway C was still being recorded, so he skittered to the lobby. However, on the way, he abruptly stopped himself.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He stared at his hands in confusion. ...What had happened? There was no glow there.{w} It didn't make any sense: he could feel the Sekimeiya's touch, but it didn't look like it was there.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Bewildered, he stepped toward the light in the lobby, and once it illuminated his hands, he saw what had happened: the Sekimeiya was no longer white.{w} Puzzled, he looked around him. A metal shutter was covering the exit, but somehow the gemstone in his hands was more bizarre.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He looked at it with concern at the same time that he recalled Lei's words. It was essential for the Sekimeiya to remain in a cold space, and it couldn't be touched outside the cabinet.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Had he damaged it? A nervous sweat broke out across his body. He lightly held the Sekimeiya with his suit instead so that he wouldn't directly contact it.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The view of hallway B was identical: not much could be seen a few steps ahead.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Atase had surely left the cleaning room already. Slowly, Katei turned its doorknob.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The cart was there. Inside it, Katei saw the second Sekimeiya. Unlike the one between his hands, it still glowed dimly.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He reached his right arm inside and took out the other Sekimeiya without touching it directly.{w} Amazed, Katei stared at it. He couldn't know if the cloth of his shirt had made a difference, but its glow hadn't vanished that time.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But the amazement quickly morphed into stupefaction. The Sekimeiya was hot.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He couldn't believe it, but there was no mistaking it: the Sekimeiya that had been in the cart was clearly warmer than everything around it. Why...? Was it also due to the absence of cold?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei had to ignore it—he was running out of time. After stepping back into the hallway, he went inside the storeroom.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He knew the secret mechanism very well. Entering the secret corridor, he placed both Sekimeiya on a suitcase lying open on the floor. He had left it there to be able to leave with the gemstones in the future.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Finally, he felt the last door, and as he did, he wondered. Would anyone see him? It couldn't be; he anticipated that everyone was in front of the main door.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...{w}Wh-What?{w} Wh-Where is it!?
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Petrified, Katei kept going through all his pockets.{w} The key wasn't there.{w} There was no way out for him without it. Desperately, he looked at all the keys he had, but none of them had the particular rust he most wanted to feel.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He realized that he must have dropped it.{w} He didn't keep it with the others, and he'd verified that he had it in the security room. Therefore, he'd dropped it in hallway A, when he'd been crawling toward the event room. Since his pocket had been so close to the floor, he hadn't noticed the sound of it falling out.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: F-Fuck! No!
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Tightening his fist, he went back to the hallway. It was drenched in darkness, but the key had to be somewhere.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He moved to the wall he'd crawled next to and repeated the action, scanning the entire surface.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Yes!
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Although he'd lost many precious seconds, he found it camouflaged under the smoke. He'd been trying to make very little noise, but he couldn't care about that anymore. As fast as he could, he ran back to the storeroom.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He stopped before the secret exit. A bright, grassy field was outside it, and he was so close to seeing it.{w} He located the keyhole and inserted the chilly key into it.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What?
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: It wasn't turning. The door wasn't opening.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: No. There's no way. Why is it...
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Something was preventing him from turning the key, and no matter how much he tried, it didn't budge. Such a thing had never happened to him before.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: They... Did they learn about this door?
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Subsumed by the darkness, Katei fell to his knees in defeat. The last method of escape, which he'd held as a trump card for years, had betrayed him.{w} The situation only became worse for him when he turned around.{w} There was nothing there.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: H-Huh?{w} Where are... the Sekimeiya?
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: The two telltale glows weren't there. When he crawled to where the suitcase should've been, he saw that it had vanished as well.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: On the floor, Katei was consumed by a wave of cold fear. He'd been outsmarted—there was no other explanation.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Two doors blocked his view into hallway A, but he was scared to leave. Xyn must've been there.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei waited. Were they going to come now that they'd defeated him?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What were they going to do? Would Katei's name be exposed? ...Those were the only thoughts he could formulate.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Katei looked up. He had heard a brief sound.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Someone was in the hallway.{w} Slowly, he rose and stepped out of the secret corridor, then gripped the doorknob.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Hallway A was still dark, but a bit more light had begun to pass through the smoke cover. That was how he saw a human figure walking to the lobby as it carried his suitcase.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It was Naomi, one of the people he was certain had fallen unconscious. Given the conversations he'd heard, Katei knew she wasn't working with Xyn.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In an instant, he ran up behind her. He had to talk to her before everyone woke up.{w} However, as soon as she heard his movements, Naomi sprinted away to escape him.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When Katei set foot in the lobby, Naomi was nowhere to be seen. The hallway B door was slightly closed, but he couldn't rush. She could easily have been hiding behind the desk or in the room below.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He stepped forward slowly. His goal was to find Naomi as soon as possible—to learn how much she knew, what had happened, what she intended to do, and to retrieve the suitcase.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But Katei didn't make it far before he turned back to the door. He heard running footsteps on the other side of the hallway.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He peered into the hallway, but the dark cloud prevented a clear line of sight. Despite that, he was able to see that someone was there, and they began to go up the stairs.{w} He ran without thinking. He had to stop Naomi no matter how much panic assaulted him.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The gray door was unlocked. That was all he needed to confirm that it was Naomi who'd gone up.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He stepped onto the second floor—the echoing sound of footsteps was clearly audible. They were still running, so he had to pursue them.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His life depended on it. He put all his strength into his legs and ran, disregarding everything else his body demanded. Rest and oxygen could wait.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: The stairs toward the fourth floor were before him. He maintained the highest speed possible, but he already knew everything was over. No matter what, the plan he'd crafted would never succeed.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before reaching the top, he tripped on a step.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He intercepted the fall with his wrist, but he couldn't immediately stand back up.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: F-Fuck!
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: When he did manage to rise, he was about to keep running. However, he realized that was a bad idea.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wait, shit...! She's going to the attic!
entries.speaker: knn

entries.text: Finally, he understood how doomed he was. He couldn't open the attic, where Naomi would lock herself with the suitcase. Continuing to go up was a futile waste of time.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In total disarray, Katei turned around. ...How much did Naomi know? Had she identified Katei...?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What was he supposed to do...? Overwhelmed, he tried to think of a course of action.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: More people were on the crystal floor. He had to act as if he'd gotten trapped like everyone else, but there were many things he had to take care of.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: His hands trembled as he walked back down. He balled them into fists and slowly released them.{w} The trembling stopped, but he was internally collapsing. Attempting a calming breath, he walked to the crystal floor, where he began to look around as if he'd been innocently imprisoned.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Tachyon Rotation
Naomi's eyes opened in pain. Before them was a pair of shoes.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She recognized them, but not the scenery behind them. ...Where was she?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A sharp sound refocused all of her senses.{w} She was in the event room, and there had just been an attack in the tower.{w} After getting that far, she almost gasped. Those shoes belonged to Katei, and what she'd heard was the cabinet opening.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: While she was still processing that information, the steps began to depart.{w} She had to stop him. At once, Naomi considered the possibility that Katei had been responsible for the smoke.{w} Her head hurt, and her limbs took a few seconds to respond. However, she was able to force her body up.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Speechless, she saw two people who she'd just met on the floor. Their names were Atsuki and Shiroya.{w} But what about the third person...? Another man had been with them, and Naomi couldn't find him.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She grabbed her glasses from the floor. Immediately, her sight blackened, as the smoke had covered the lenses. Trying not to inhale what lingered of it in the air, she slowly staggered to hallway A, wondering how long she'd been asleep and cleaning her glasses with her sleeves.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Six people had fallen unconscious. When the smoke was released, Naomi had been looking at the cabinet; out of all of them, she'd been the farthest from the source, as everyone else had been next to a grenade.{w} Atase had faked his unconsciousness, meaning that in the event room, Naomi's was the only adult body to be knocked out. Added to the lesser quantity of smoke that she inhaled, she would've been the first to awaken.{w} Because of that, when Katei stepped next to her ears, she was brought back to reality minutes before everyone else.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She couldn't believe the appearance of the hallway. Like in the event room, a dark, sticky coating was everywhere, blocking out the light. Thanks to hallway C's ceiling light, though, she was able to see the storeroom closing.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It had been Katei, hadn't it...? She'd spoken to him a few times, but she'd never gotten a specific impression of him.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Approaching the storeroom, Naomi hoped she'd been mistaken. Katei should've been in the security room, so perhaps he was acting against the attack by protecting the target.{w} Outside the door, she heard a noise.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What was it...? It sounded like a door was being forced open, but that didn't make any sense.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: When it stopped, Naomi heard the person approaching and sharply burst to her side out of fear of being attacked.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...It was Katei. However, he didn't see Naomi, and instead, he rushed back into the darkness.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: As soon as Naomi peeked inside the vacant room, her mouth dropped.{w} What the hell was she seeing? The wall was open...
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: All doubts vanished from her mind: Katei was behind the attack. A corridor extended beyond the wall—one she'd never known about. As much as she couldn't believe it, it explained a lot of things.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, she took notice of a glow on the floor. ...The Sekimeiya.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Concealing her footsteps, she approached the faint light. It was in a suitcase, and it appeared both gemstones were there. Slowly, she closed it and brought it out of the room.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Although she couldn't see anyone, she was able to perceive Katei nearby. He was there, in the hallway.{w} Wishing not to be seen, she sprinted toward hallway C.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Before she could breathe steadily, she heard Katei getting closer. Without moving her eyes, Naomi continued to take slow steps back.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But Katei wasn't coming for her. He simply reentered the storeroom.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That was when Naomi finally thought about how strange everything was. What was that silence? What had happened after she'd lost consciousness?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: From where she was, she could see that hallway B looked the same. Something of large scale had happened, so why was nobody else there?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She felt frozen, and clueless as to what to do. ...At least, she had retrieved the Sekimeiya.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She had to leave. The exit was on the other side of the hallways, but she could only see a dark void.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Was someone else there? She hesitated, scared to surround herself with the darkness.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Holding tightly onto the suitcase, she took a step forward. A thin fog obscured her vision, but the lobby door shortly came into view.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However, alarm bells went off in her head. Someone was behind her, running at full speed.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She couldn't look back. With the scarce energy she had, she went through the door.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wh—
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Her eyes went wider than ever before. A metal shutter was in front of the door.{w} It didn't make any sense, but she didn't have time to think. She had to keep running.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Covering her face, she ran through hallway B. When she returned to where she'd been, she confirmed she wasn't being chased anymore.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She couldn't leave the building. It was ridiculous, but a huge piece of metal she'd never seen was blocking the way out. If Katei was the one who'd run behind her, there was only one place where she'd be safe.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She tried to open the elevator, but it wasn't on that floor.{w} She couldn't wait for it, so she took out her keys and dashed up the stairs.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She unlocked the gray door, but she couldn't waste time locking it behind her; if her pursuer was Katei, he had that key as well.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She didn't slow down. Once she was on the third floor, a sound alerted her: she was being chased again.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Through the many floors of the tower, her goal was to make it to the attic. The Sekimeiya bounced inside the suitcase, and Naomi gripped the key without stopping once.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: At last, the final floor was in sight, and nobody was behind her.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: With the key, she locked the door behind her.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She had made it; Katei wouldn't be able to reach that place. Panting, she went up the narrow staircase.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Naomi stepped to the sofa, where she dropped her keys and the suitcase. Exhausted, she took a moment to catch her breath. The bright living room looked nothing like the lowest floor.{w} When she opened the case, she saw both identical gemstones. Even though she'd brought them to safety, she'd been told the cabinet's temperature was essential for their well-being.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Huh...?
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Something was strange. The interior of the suitcase was very hot. Naomi felt around in it and gripped it tightly, unable to comprehend why it had heated up so much.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wh-What!?
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Out of nowhere, both of the Sekimeiya vanished.{w} Astonished, Naomi stared at the empty suitcase. She had felt one of their white surfaces for an instant before both had disappeared.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She couldn't comprehend what had occurred; it wasn't possible. They couldn't have disappeared.{w} ...However, they weren't there anymore.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wha...!
entries.speaker: sann

entries.text: Then, she noticed something else was gone: her keys, which she'd left next to the suitcase.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She questioned her own memories. She had just left the keyring there, hadn't she...?{w} Or had she left it in the keyhole?{w} Speechless, she peeked down the stairs.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: It... wasn't there. But it wasn't on the sofa either.{w} She couldn't understand. How could her keys have disappeared with the Sekimeiya? It was utterly nonsensical.{w} She'd looked through the sofa, the suitcase, and all her pockets; they really weren't anywhere.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Wondering if she'd gone insane, Naomi walked to the hallway. She knew the layout of the attic well, and she was sure she was alone.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: She'd intended to keep the Sekimeiya in a safe place, but somehow, she'd failed. Completely lost, she wondered what to do.{w} More people were on the crystal floor, and they could have already woken up.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: However... she couldn't leave. Without the key, she couldn't unlock the door she'd just locked, so she pressed the elevator button.{w} ...But nothing happened.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Naomi couldn't believe her situation, but no matter how much she thought about it, she didn't think she was wrong about what had happened: she'd seen the Sekimeiya disappear before her eyes, so the same must have happened with the keys.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: ...What had happened in the tower? Had she been hallucinating everything since she'd fallen unconscious? She simply couldn't accept that she'd trapped herself in the attic.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: But she had. Alone on the highest floor of the tower, Naomi had no method of escape.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: And so began the day.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: How did it end, however?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Bioluminescent
{w=0.6}My body crumpled down; I couldn't keep going.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A month? What kind of joke was that? I couldn't bear one more second.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Shiroya's words played back in my head. "Don't forget what I said... I meant all of it."
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I laughed, alone. I didn't know where I was, what anything had become... none of it. Nothing we'd done had any meaning. We'd made it to the end of that impossibly long day for nothing.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The words Shiroya had abandoned me with... Were they supposed to be reassuring?
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I tried to continue yelling her name, but my voice broke. She'd known what would happen and hadn't warned us. She'd kept waiting at our side, bolstering our hope, until she'd run away.{w} Why...!? She would never have done that... I couldn't let a single day change my view of her.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: But I couldn't help but despair. I wanted to leave. I wanted to be hit by the icy air and feel released. I wanted to talk to more people, even if they were the police.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And it wouldn't happen. Could we survive an entire month? Of course not...! Shiroya hadn't been mentioned in the recording, so would I not see her for weeks?
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Would the nightmare persist in the Sekimeiya's domain? It was too horrible of a thought to bear. People had died, and I still didn't know who, how, why...
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The lights had gone out, so I followed their example. I closed my eyes, intensifying the darkness, before I felt once again how insignificant I was.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I—{w=0.4}Isla?{w=0.5} Where...?
entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: Erina's voice came from the hallway.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Sh-She's not here!
entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: What?
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: Where is she...!?
entries.speaker: aki4

entries.text: What are you talking about?
entries.speaker: sai4

entries.text: Sai sounded confused too, near the end of hallway A.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: She's not here? Could she mean...?
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I mustered the strength to scramble back out of the lobby.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Look! She isn't in the cabinet!
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I entered the crystal room. Although I knew its walls were stained dark, I couldn't differentiate them from the rest.{w} I stepped to the cabinet where Isla rested and reached my hand inside.{w} ...She wasn't there.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Y-You're right...{w} She was here just minutes ago.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What the fuck? Did Shiroya take her out?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...What? Why would she do that?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I'm sure you can explain why she did everything else.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What if she was saved? That could be it, right?
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Well, something just happened. That's for sure.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I followed Sai out.{w} Utterly lost, we went to check the bathrooms.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Man, what the fuck is this?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Naomi isn't here either...
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: We ran to the crystal room where we'd found her first body.{w} It wasn't there. The curtain wasn't on the floor either.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Did all the bodies disappear? In that case, Katei's must not be in the security room either, but why the hell is it locked?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: And it wasn't only the bodies. We had thought that if the exit didn't unlock at {time=21}, we would let the others listen to the recording. However, that could no longer happen; the recorder itself had certainly vanished alongside Isla.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Atsuki, when the lights went out, did you really not see anything?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I... didn't see anything, no.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Then why did Erina and I see a flashing light? It lasted an instant, but I find it really strange that it didn't happen to you.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I don't know. I have no idea...!
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Why was I the only one to not see that...? Could that indicate what happened?{w} Shiroya ran to hallway B and told us to not follow her. Was she going to the Sekimeiya in the cabinet?{w} Then, out of nowhere, the lights went off, and the shutter remained unmoving.
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: What the fuck had happened? Shiroya's face had looked the opposite of malicious, so why would she have done anything harmful? She couldn't have trapped us there for an entire month...!
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina was behind us, and she sounded like she was in pain. Although we couldn't see it, it appeared her finger had started bleeding out of nowhere.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Erina, before the lights went off, you went to the mechanical room, right?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...{w}Y-Yes.
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Why?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...I thought maybe someone was there. We still have to find Akaro.
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: There's no way you believe her, right?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}The light breakers are there. Did you turn them off? What the hell happened to your finger?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: What!? How would I have done that? They're locked up, and there's still electricity. The cameras are working.
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: I glanced at the ceiling of the hallway, where the faint green lights of the cameras could be seen.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: A-And I don't know, but it really hurts! Did you just hear that? A drop of blood fell to the floor, but I can't see what kind of injury I have!
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: You could've only turned off the breakers that control the light, right?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Go check them! You'll see that I didn't touch any!
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Did the light go off in the mechanical room?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes!
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Then how are we supposed to check them!? We can't see anything!
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Doesn't your wristwatch give off some light?
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Do you think this is gonna do anything!?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai lit his watch's blue screen, but it didn't illuminate anything in front of it.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Is Shiroya still here? ...Is she currently listening to us?
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: "Don't forget what I said... I meant all of it."{w} If she's not here anymore, then who did this? It can't be just a coincidence that Erina left our side minutes before the shutter was going to open.
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: A month in the tower... That was impossible. There was no way that fate awaited us, but merely thinking about it was almost enough to make me lose my grip on reality.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I couldn't stand it anymore. I wanted to know what was happening...! I wanted to know what had been going on since the start!
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: "Now stay here, and don't follow me."{w} Why!? Why did I have to stay there!? Leaving the tower with Shiroya was the only thing I wanted—it was the only thing both of us wanted!
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...Are the other floors going to be like this too?
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: You're asking as if I have a clue.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We trudged along, bit by bit. In hallway C, Sai tried to open the elevator.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's not here.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: He found the button on the wall and pressed it.{w} A while later, it still hadn't lit up.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Unless it's open on another floor, the elevator is disabled too.{w} I didn't want to use it, though. Let's take the stairs.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Wh-What the...?{w} What happened to the lights?
entries.speaker: q

entries.text: That voice...
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: I turned around to where it had come from.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Whose voice was it?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: What do you think? What are the remaining mysteries that you have solved?
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Perhaps you would like to prove yourself as well. You will have the chance to do that.{w} Show that the peak is also awaiting you—that the keys you were given were put to use.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Exactly, Akaro's return. That was what the voice signified.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: From here on out, you'll be able to submit your own answers for the mysteries of this story and show what you've solved. At the end, you'll have access to the total number of correct answers, but your performance won't influence the story. Best of luck.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Unfortunately, that is incorrect. Don't worry, though, as this is just the beginning.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: From here on out, you'll be able to submit your own answers for the mysteries of this story and show what you've solved. At the end, you'll have access to the total number of correct answers, but your performance won't influence the story. Best of luck.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: A-Akaro! Is that you?
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Huh? Yes! ...Where am I!?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: What the fuck do you mean!? We haven't seen you in hours!
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What? What time is it? We're still in the tower, right?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Of course we are, and it's past {time=21}! The shutter didn't open!
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: W-Wait, what!? That can't be...!
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Cut it out! Where the fuck have you been!?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What does that mean!? I just touched the Sekimeiya and appeared here!
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Where? When did you touch it?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: U-Uh... it was...
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Spit it out! Was it after we escaped from the attic's bedroom? I don't even give a shit anymore!
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Y-Yes.
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: You son of a bitch! He punched me in the stomach!{w} I was knocked out, and when I woke up, I couldn't even stand up straight!
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...I told him to tell me where he put the Sekimeiya since I knew he had it. I just touched it on the crystal floor, and the lights went off.
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Are you saying that you traveled forward in time? You're a fucking liar.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm not lying!
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: My mind was worn out, but what Akaro was saying didn't make sense. I had seen him earlier, before Shiroya had run up to the attic.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I don't care if you don't believe me, just tell me what the fuck happened! Why are the lights off, and where is everyone else!?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: You were gone for six hours! Do you think I'm gonna believe that nonsense!? Katei died, and God knows where Shiroya is!
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Wait, what!? Katei was killed...?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes!
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What about Isla?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I-Isla...? Y-You... know what happened, right...?
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Yes, but she was here again!{w} Sai, why did you go quiet!? You saw her as well!
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...{w}I don't know what happened.{w} She was alive when we left the attic. We talked to her, but she didn't remember anything about what had happened. After this son of a bitch knocked me out, I wasn't able to find her again.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What...!? You never said that! That means she's alive! The recording was right—she'll be here!
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: What recording?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...{w}Can you please answer me? Why are the lights off!? There's no way it's {time=21.}
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Sai stabbed his wristwatch with one finger.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It's {time=21:12}, dumbass! And we don't know what happened! The lights went off just minutes before the shutter was gonna open, and we have no idea why!
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That's not all that happened. The dead bodies disappeared too. It wasn't just the light.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: That was why Akaro's story was unbelievable. Had he traveled... to the future? Was that possible?{w} Even if it was, his appearance didn't make sense. Something had happened at {time=21} that went against the normal flow of time. I didn't think that Akaro could've simply traveled forward in time to appear where we were.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Wait a second! What the fuck are...{w} these clothes?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Huh?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I'm not wearing the clothes I was wearing before! What the fuck!?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Speechless, we stepped over to his voice. Once I felt the texture of his shirt, I realized it wasn't the one he'd been wearing before.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Ah, the Sekimeiya changed your clothes. Is that right?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Th-That's what happened! They just changed!
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: You're several galaxies out of your mind if you think we'll believe anything that you're saying. What the fuck is your goal?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Are they yours?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: These clothes...?{w} I... think so. They're not the ones I had on, though!
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: I had no idea what to believe. Had the Sekimeiya made Akaro travel to the future? Had it swapped his clothing...? I couldn't rule anything out as impossible, but it wasn't easy to trust him.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: If he was telling the truth... who was the Akaro I'd seen? His existence had gradually gotten harder to comprehend.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: You're really saying the shutter is still there...?{w} We're in hallway C, right?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Hugging the wall, Akaro walked to the lobby.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: It is... It really is still here.{w} Is it actually after {time=21}? What the fuck do we do, then!?
entries.speaker: ak4

entries.text: What the fuck do you think we can do!? Nothing!
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Despite being aware of another option for so long, there was another choice. We had the Sekimeiya.{w} We could travel through time. According to Akaro, he had traveled hours forward, so nothing said we couldn't escape the tower with it.{w} The reason I hadn't explored that option yet was what Shiroya had said. Due to her, I wasn't sure that trying to escape from the dark tower was what I had to do. However, Sai and Akaro weren't even discussing the Sekimeiya. Supposedly, Akaro had just appeared, and he hadn't even asked about its whereabouts.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: And... you said Shiroya is gone? What happened to her?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: We don't know! If you're not behind whatever just happened, it must be her! She ran away before the lights went out and said not to follow her. She should be somewhere.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai, you've reiterated that you know more about the Sekimeiya than us, and you haven't fundamentally denied what Akaro said. Does that mean that traveling to the future is possible?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: ...I don't know. Even if it was, would you really believe the nonsense he's spewing?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: You're the one spewing nonsense! Why would the exit not unlock!? One of you killed Katei, right? Who was it!?{w} And what, the bodies disappeared? Have you searched for them? We know the Sekimeiya doesn't make them vanish, right? Is it even in the cabinet?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: ...Yes.{w} And we were planning to search through the higher floors. We don't even know if the lights went off up there, but the elevator doesn't work, and the security room is locked for some reason.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: What...? I'm really going to lose it. I have no idea how I've gone through all of this without losing it already.
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Shut the fuck up! If you're telling the truth, we've been here twice as long as you!{w} Let's just go up. We can hope there's still light somewhere.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: That put the discussion on pause. I couldn't believe my legs were still obeying me, but I proceeded up the stairs.{w} Was there anything to find? ...Shiroya? Maybe Isla...? I had moved beyond taking things for granted.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Once we went through the gray door, we saw that the darkness would likely persist.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Did the lights really go out everywhere?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Seems so.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Even if there's something to find, there's no way we can find it.
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: And if someone else is here, they're staying away from us on purpose. We should go all the way up first.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We went around the floor without entering the offices. Our steps echoed loudly in comparison to the more muffled corridors on the first floor.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Gripping the handrail, we went up the stairs step by step.{w} On the third floor, I wondered if we would even be able to step into the attic. Perhaps Sai had a second key, but the original one should've been in the inner keyhole, and it could've already been taken.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: We were all disheartened. Silently, we arrived on the sixth floor, though we could only know because we'd counted the stairwells.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The door's unlocked.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Sai opened the door to the attic, but we didn't see anything ahead of us.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The key's still inserted here. ...It doesn't seem like there's light above, though.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: We stepped up the narrow staircase. At the top, we confirmed no light was on the final floor either.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Fuck, man. Do we really have to stay in the dark?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: As if having light would be that much better.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...Hang on.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I stepped forward, toward the table.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After fiddling with a cable, I pressed a switch.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh, the lamp!
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: It works, thank God. I wasn't sure if it would, but it'll do.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I looked at everyone and almost fell back. It took me a second to notice that the man behind Erina was Akaro. Not only were his clothes different, but also his hair—he was hardly recognizable.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Oh my God! Th-The tip of my finger is cut! L-Look how much blood I'm losing!
entries.speaker: aki

entries.text: Erina looked inside her purse and brought out bandages. Grimacing from the sight of the blood, she covered her finger with them.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: The bedrooms... had a lamp as well, right?
entries.speaker: ak

entries.text: Yes.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Thanks to them, we were able to light up the bedrooms, and by opening the doors, the hallway, kitchen, and bathroom were slightly illuminated as well.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Two of those places contained a minor indication that shed light on their situation, but in a third one was the biggest clue.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Precisely. It was in the kitchen.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Initially, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left in the living room were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In the living room, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: He frowned and moved on, unaware that another place held a much stronger clue.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} Confused, he stepped out.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There was nothing in the storeroom that indicated where they were.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In the living room, however, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} Confused, he stepped out.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: There was nothing in the bathroom that indicated where they were.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In the living room, however, Atsuki noticed that the footprints they'd just left were the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Then, he saw that the inner handle of the right bedroom was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} Confused, he stepped out.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: In the right bedroom, Atsuki noticed that the inner handle was unattached, like it had been minutes prior.{w} He had seen that in the living room, the footprints they'd just left had been the only ones. It was very strange; fainter ones should've been there as well.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: Confused, he stepped out, unaware that another place held a much stronger clue.
entries.speaker: c

entries.text: That glass...
entries.speaker: nm

entries.text: There was a glass next to the sink.{w} I recognized it—when I'd been with Shiroya, I had tried to drink tap water. It had tasted terrible, and I'd set it aside.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: After that time, I had seen the glass again. But there was a major distinction between that glass and the one I was looking at.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: Specifically, it had since become empty.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: H-Hey, guys! Come to the kitchen.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Everyone entered.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What do you want?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Did any of you pour out the water in this glass?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: I didn't.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Everyone denied it with confusion.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: I left it here a few hours ago, and it was filled with water. I don't think it moved either.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: So it vanished on its own?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Yes.
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Sai frowned.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: What, did it evaporate?
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: Water evaporates at any temperature that doesn't freeze it, right?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Atsuki, we're indoors. The air isn't moving, and it's not hot at all. It could take a month for the water in a glass to evaporate.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: ...A month?
entries.speaker: a

entries.text: Yes.
entries.speaker: sai

entries.text: I silently stared back at Sai, wondering if he was thinking what I was.
entries.speaker: i

entries.text: ...What, do you think we traveled into the future? A month into the future?
